children.translated_text: Uttering the root mantra once, drawing in the breath; uttering it three times, retaining the breath; uttering it once, exhaling. Thus performing exhalation, inhalation, and retention three, seven, ten, or sixteen times, [the practitioner becomes] one whose body is made of radiance.

children.text: ṣaḍ-aṅgaṃ bālā-sahitāṃ mātṛkāṃ mūla-hṛn-mukheṣu rati-prīti-manobhavān vinyasya || Parks_6.11 ||
children.translated_text: Placing the <s>ṣaḍaṅga</s> (six limbs), the <s>mātṛkā</s> (alphabet) accompanied by <s>Bālā</s>, and <s>Rati</s>, <s>Prīti</s>, and <s>Manobhava</s> on the root, heart, and mouth [centers].

children.text: mūlaṃ saptadaśadhā khaṇḍayitvā ṣaṭ brahma-bile trīṇi lalāṭe catvāri bhrū-madhye dakṣa-vāmekṣaṇayoḥ ṣaṭ câṣṭau saptâsye dakṣa-vāma-śruti-kaṇṭheṣv ekaikaṃ dakṣa-vāmâṃsayor aṣṭau ca daśa hṛdi daśa dakṣa-vāma-stanayor aṣṭāv aṣṭau nava nābhau dviḥ svādhiṣṭhāne ṣaḍ ādhāra evaṃ vinyasya || Parks_6.12 ||
children.translated_text: Dividing the root mantra into seventeen parts: six at the <s>brahma-bila</s> (fontanelle), three at the forehead, four between the eyebrows, six each at the right and left eyes, eight and seven at the mouth, one each at the right and left ears and throat, eight each at the right and left shoulders, ten at the heart, ten each at the right and left breasts, eight and eight and nine at the navel, two at the <s>svādhiṣṭhāna</s> (sacral center), six at the <s>ādhāra</s> (root center) — thus placing [them].

children.text: punar ādhārâdi-brahma-bila-paryantaṃ saptadaśa-khaṇḍān ukta-sthāneṣu vinyasya || Parks_6.13 ||
children.translated_text: Again placing the seventeen parts from the <s>ādhāra</s> (root center) to the <s>brahma-bila</s> (fontanelle) in the aforementioned locations.

children.text: amṛtodadhi-madhya-ratna-dvīpe muktā-mālâdy-alaṅkṛtaṃ catur-dvāra-sahitaṃ maṇḍapaṃ vicintya tasya prāg-ādi-catur-dvāreṣu - sāṃ sarasvatyai, lāṃ lakṣmyai, śaṃ śaṅkha-nidhaye, paṃ padma-nidhaye namaḥ - lāṃ indrāya vajra-hastāya surâdhipataye airāvata-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - rāṃ agnaye śakti-hastāya tejo-'dhipataye aja-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - ṭāṃ yamāya daṇḍa-hastāya pretâdhipataye mahiṣa-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - kṣāṃ nirṛtaye khaḍga-hastāya rakṣo-'dhipataye nara-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - vāṃ varuṇāya pāśa-hastāya jalâdhipataye makara-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - yāṃ vāyave dhvaja-hastāya prāṇâdhipataye ruru-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - sāṃ somāya śaṅkha-hastāya nakṣatrâdhipataye aśva-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - hāṃ īśānāya triśūla-hastāya vidyā-'dhipataye vṛṣabha-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - oṃ brahmaṇe padma-hastāya satya-lokâdhipataye haṃsa-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - śrīṃ viṣṇave cakra-hastāya nāgâdhipataye garuḍa-vāhanāya sa-parivārāya namaḥ - oṃ vāstu-pataye brahmaṇe namaḥ - ity ekādaśa-dikṣu ekādaśa-devān arcayet || Parks_6.14 ||
children.translated_text: Meditating upon a pavilion adorned with pearl garlands etc., with four doors, in the middle of an ocean of nectar on a jeweled island; at its four doors beginning from the east: 'sāṃ to <s>Sarasvatī</s>, lāṃ to <s>Lakṣmī</s>, śaṃ to <s>Śaṅkha-nidhi</s> (Conch Treasure), paṃ to <s>Padma-nidhi</s> (Lotus Treasure), namaḥ' — 'lāṃ to <s>Indra</s>, vajra-handed, lord of the gods, whose vehicle is <s>Airāvata</s>, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'rāṃ to <s>Agni</s>, spear-handed, lord of splendor, whose vehicle is the goat, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'ṭāṃ to <s>Yama</s>, staff-handed, lord of the departed, whose vehicle is the buffalo, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'kṣāṃ to <s>Nirṛti</s>, sword-handed, lord of <s>rākṣasas</s>, whose vehicle is a man, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'vāṃ to <s>Varuṇa</s>, noose-handed, lord of waters, whose vehicle is the crocodile, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'yāṃ to <s>Vāyu</s>, banner-handed, lord of breath, whose vehicle is the deer, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'sāṃ to <s>Soma</s>, conch-handed, lord of the stars, whose vehicle is the horse, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'hāṃ to <s>Īśāna</s>, trident-handed, lord of knowledge, whose vehicle is the bull, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'oṃ to <s>Brahmā</s>, lotus-handed, lord of the world of truth, whose vehicle is the swan, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'śrīṃ to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, discus-handed, lord of the <s>nāgas</s>, whose vehicle is <s>Garuḍa</s>, with retinue, namaḥ' — 'oṃ to <s>Vāstu-pati</s> <s>Brahmā</s>, namaḥ' — thus one should worship the eleven deities in the eleven directions.

children.text: śyāmā-krama-mantrāṇām ādau tritārī-kumārī-yogaḥ kumārī-yogo vā, tritārī pūrvoktā kumārī bālā śeṣam uttānam || Parks_6.15 ||
children.translated_text: At the beginning of the mantras of the <s>Śyāmā-krama</s>, there is the conjunction of the <s>tritārī</s> and <s>Kumārī</s>, or the conjunction of <s>Kumārī</s> alone. The <s>tritārī</s> is as previously stated; <s>Kumārī</s> is <s>Bālā</s>. The rest is straightforward.

children.text: gandha-dravyeṇa liptâṅgas tāmbūlâmodita-vadanaḥ prasanna-manā bhūtvā || Parks_6.16 ||
children.translated_text: Having anointed the body with fragrant substances, with mouth freshened by betel, becoming cheerful-minded.

children.text: suvarṇa-rajata-tāmra-candana-maṇḍaleṣu bindu-tri-koṇa-pañca-koṇâṣṭa-dala-ṣoḍaśa-dalâṣṭa-dala-catur-dala-catur-asrâtmakaṃ cakra-rājaṃ vilikhya || Parks_6.17 ||
children.translated_text: Drawing the <s>cakra-rāja</s> (king of diagrams) — consisting of <s>bindu</s>, triangle, pentagon, eight petals, sixteen petals, eight petals, four petals, and square — on maṇḍalas of gold, silver, copper, or sandalwood.

children.text: mūlena trivāra-japtena śuddha-jalena catur-asra-vṛtta-ṣaṭ-koṇa-tri-koṇa-bindūn praveśena matsya-mudrayā vidhāya - aṃ ātma-tattvāya ādhāra-śaktaye vauṣaṭ - ity ādhāraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dhūmrârcir ūṣmā jvalinī jvālinī visphuliṅginī su-śrīḥ su-rūpā kapilā havya-vāhā kavya-vāhety agni-kalā abhyarcya - uṃ vidyā-tattvāya padmânanāya vauṣaṭ - iti pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya - tapinī tāpinī dhūmrā marīcir jvālinī ruciḥ suṣumnā bhoga-dā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā - iti pātre sūrya-kalā abhyarcya - maṃ śiva-tattvāya soma-maṇḍalāya namaḥ - iti śuddha-jalam āpūrya - amṛtā māna-dā pūṣā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭī ratiḥ dhṛtiḥ śaśinī candrikā kāntir jyotsnā śrīḥ prītir aṅga-dā pūrṇā pūrṇâmṛtā - ceti candra-kalā abhyarcya agnîśâsura-vāyuṣu madhye dikṣu ca ṣaḍ-aṅgāni vinyasya astreṇa saṃrakṣya kavacenâvakuṇṭhya dhenu-yonī pradarśya - mūla-mantreṇa saptaśo 'bhimantrya taj-jala-vipruḍbhiḥ yāga-gṛhaṃ pūjopakaraṇāni câvokṣya || Parks_6.18 ||
children.translated_text: Having recited the root <s>mantra</s> three times, with pure water, forming the square, circle, hexagon, triangle, and <s>bindu</s> by entering, with the fish <s>mudrā</s> — having established the support (<s>ādhāra</s>) with '<s>aṃ ātmatattvāya ādhāraśaktaye vauṣaṭ</s>' — one should worship the fire-digits: <s>Dhūmrā</s>, <s>Arcis</s>, <s>Ūṣmā</s>, <s>Jvalinī</s>, <s>Jvālinī</s>, <s>Visphuliṅginī</s>, <s>Suśrī</s>, <s>Surūpā</s>, <s>Kapilā</s>, <s>Havyavāhā</s>, and <s>Kavyavāhā</s>.

children.text: tābhir ī-kārâṅkita-tri-koṇa-vṛtta-catur-asraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vidhāya tasmin puṣpāṇi vikīrya pūrva-vad ādhāraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya agni-kalā abhyarcya pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tasmin pātre hrīṃ aiṃ mahā-lakṣmîśvari parama-svāmini ūrdhva- [199] śūnya-pravāhini soma-sūryâgni-bhakṣiṇi paramâkāśa-bhāsure āgacchâgaccha viśa viśa pātraṃ pratigṛhṇa pratigṛhṇa huṃ phaṭ svāheti puṣpâñjaliṃ vikīrya sūrya-kalā abhyarcya
children.translated_text: With those, having formed a <s>maṇḍala</s> of a triangle, circle, and square marked with the letter <s>ī</s>, having scattered flowers therein, establishing the support as before, worshiping the fire-digits, placing the vessel — in that vessel: '<s>hrīṃ aiṃ</s> O <s>Mahālakṣmīśvarī</s>, supreme mistress, flowing from the upper void, consuming <s>Soma</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, and <s>Agni</s>, shining in the supreme space, come, come...'

children.text: brahmāṇḍâkhaṇḍa-sambhūtam aśeṣa-rasa-sambhṛtam |
children.translated_text:
Born from the undivided cosmic egg,
filled with every essence,

children.text: āpūritaṃ mahā-pātraṃ pīyūṣa-rasam āvaha ||
children.translated_text:
Bring the nectar-liquid,
filling the great vessel.

children.text: ity ādimam āpūrya dvitīyaṃ nikṣipya a-ka-thâdi-tri-rekhā-'ṅkita-koṇa-traye ha-la-kṣān madhye haṃsaṃ ca vilikhya - mūlena daśadhā abhimantrya - candra-kalāḥ abhyarcya - agnîśâsura-vāyuṣu madhye dikṣu, ṣaḍ-aṅgāni vinyasya - astreṇa saṃrakṣya - kavacenâvakuṇṭhya, dhenu-yonī pradarśayet || Parks_6.19 ||
children.translated_text: Thus filling the first, placing the second, inscribing <s>ha-la-kṣa</s> in the three corners marked with the lines of <s>a-ka-tha</s> and so forth, and <s>haṃsa</s> in the center — consecrating ten times with the root <s>mantra</s> — worshiping the moon-digits — placing the six limbs in the fire, <s>Īśa</s>, <s>asura</s>, and wind quarters, in the center and in the directions — protecting with the weapon <s>mantra</s> — covering with the armor — one should display the cow and womb <s>mudrās</s>.

children.text: cakra-madhye śrī-mātam uktvā gîśvarī-mūrtaye namaḥ - iti mūrtiṃ kalpayitvā bhūyaḥ śrī-mātam uktvā gîśvary-amṛta-caitanyam āvāhayāmi - ity āvāhya, ṣoḍaśabhir upacarya āśuśukṣaṇi-tryakṣa-rakṣaḥ-prabhañjana-dikṣu devyā maulau paritaś ca pūjyā aṅga-devyaḥ | tan-mantrāḥ sarva-janâdayaḥ aṣṭau saptaikādaśa daśa punar daśâṣṭāviṃśati-khaṇḍāḥ tritārī-kumārī-vāg-ādayaḥ sa-jātayaḥ sāmānya-manu-yuktāḥ || Parks_6.20 ||
children.translated_text: In the center of the <s>cakra</s>, having uttered '<s>Śrīmāta</s>' and saying '<s>Gīśvarīmūrtaye namaḥ</s>,' having formed the image; again uttering '<s>Śrīmāta</s>' and saying '<s>Gīśvary-amṛta-caitanyam āvāhayāmi</s>' — invoking; having offered the sixteen services; the limb-deities should be worshiped in the <s>āśuśukṣaṇi</s>, three-eyed, <s>rakṣas</s>-destroying, and directional positions, at the crown and all around the <s>Devī</s>. Their <s>mantras</s> begin with '<s>Sarvajanā</s>' — eight, seven, eleven...

children.text: paścād āvaraṇa-pūjāṃ kuryāt || Parks_6.21 ||
children.translated_text: Afterward, one should perform the enclosure worship (<s>āvaraṇapūjā</s>).

children.text: sarva-cakra-devatā-'rcanāni vāma-karâṅguṣṭhânāmikā-sandaṣṭa-dvitīya-śakala-gṛhīta-śrī-pātra-prathama-bindu-sahapatitaiḥ dakṣa-karâkṣata-puṣpa-kṣepaiḥ kuryāt || Parks_6.22 ||
children.translated_text: All the worship of the deities of every <s>cakra</s> should be performed by letting drops fall from the first part of the sacred vessel held between the thumb and ring finger of the left hand into the second part, together with the casting of unbroken rice and flowers with the right hand.

children.text: tri-koṇe rati-prīti-manobhavān || Parks_6.23 ||
children.translated_text: In the triangle: <s>Rati</s>, <s>Prīti</s>, and <s>Manobhava</s> (Love, Delight, and Desire).

children.text: pañcâra-mūle pura ādi-krameṇa drāṃ drāvaṇa-bāṇāya - drīṃ śoṣaṇa-bāṇāya - klīṃ bandhana-bāṇāya - blūṃ mohana-bāṇāya - saḥ unmādana-bāṇāya namaḥ - iti tad-agre māyā-kāma-vāg-blūṃ strīm upajuṣṭāḥ kāma-manmatha-kandarpa-makara-ketana-manobhavāḥ || Parks_6.24 ||
children.translated_text: At the base of the five spokes, in the city in the original order: '<s>drāṃ</s> to the Melting Arrow' — '<s>drīṃ</s> to the Desiccating Arrow' — '<s>klīṃ</s> to the Binding Arrow' — '<s>blūṃ</s> to the Bewildering Arrow' — '<s>saḥ</s> to the Maddening Arrow, <s>namaḥ</s>.' At their tips, endowed with <s>māyā</s>-<s>kāma</s>-<s>vāk</s>-<s>blūṃ</s>-<s>strīṃ</s>: <s>Kāma</s>, <s>Manmatha</s>, <s>Kandarpa</s>, <s>Makaraketana</s>, and <s>Manobhava</s>.

children.text: aṣṭa-dala-mūle brāhmī-maheśvarī-kaumārī-vaiṣṇavī-vārāhī-māhendrī-cāmuṇḍā-caṇḍikāḥ, sendu-svara-yugmântyâdayaḥ pūjyāḥ | tad-agre lakṣmī-sarasvatī-rati-prīti-kīrti-śānti-puṣṭi-tuṣṭayaḥ || Parks_6.25 ||
children.translated_text: At the base of the eight petals: <s>Brāhmī</s>, <s>Maheśvarī</s>, <s>Kaumārī</s>, <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>, <s>Vārāhī</s>, <s>Māhendrī</s>, <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s>, and <s>Caṇḍikā</s>, beginning with <s>bindu</s>-vowel pairs, to be worshiped. At their tips: <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Rati</s>, <s>Prīti</s>, <s>Kīrti</s>, <s>Śānti</s>, <s>Puṣṭi</s>, and <s>Tuṣṭi</s>.

children.text: ṣoḍaśa-dale vāmā-jyeṣṭhā-raudrī-śānti-śraddhā-sarasvatī-kriyāśakti-lakṣmī-sṛṣṭi-mohinī-pramathinī-āśvāsinī-vīcī-vidyunmālinī-surânandā-nāgabuddhikāḥ || Parks_6.26 ||
children.translated_text: On the sixteen petals: <s>Vāmā</s>, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, <s>Raudrī</s>, <s>Śānti</s>, <s>Śraddhā</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Kriyāśakti</s>, <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>Sṛṣṭi</s>, <s>Mohinī</s>, <s>Pramathinī</s>, <s>Āśvāsinī</s>, <s>Vīcī</s>, <s>Vidyunmālinī</s>, <s>Surānandā</s>, and <s>Nāgabuddhikā</s>.

children.text: aṣṭa-dale asitâṅga-ruru-caṇḍa-krodhana-unmatta-kapāla-bhīṣaṇa-saṃhārāḥ sa-daṇḍi-svara-yugmâdi-saṃyuktā bhairavântāś ca bhāvanīyāḥ || Parks_6.27 ||
children.translated_text: On the eight petals: <s>Asitāṅga</s>, <s>Ruru</s>, <s>Caṇḍa</s>, <s>Krodhana</s>, <s>Unmatta</s>, <s>Kapāla</s>, <s>Bhīṣaṇa</s>, and <s>Saṃhāra</s>, conjoined with <s>daṇḍi</s>-vowel pairs, ending with '<s>Bhairava</s>' — they should be contemplated.

children.text: catur-dalaṃ mā-yukta-taṅgī siddha-lakṣmīś ca mahā-mā-yukta-taṅgī mahā-siddha-lakṣmīś ca || Parks_6.28 ||
children.translated_text: On the four petals: with <s>mā-yukta-taṅgī</s>, <s>Siddhalakṣmī</s>; and with <s>mahā-mā-yukta-taṅgī</s>, <s>Mahāsiddhalakṣmī</s>.

children.text: gaṃ gaṇapati - duṃ durgā - baṃ baṭuka - kṣaṃ kṣetra-pālāḥ, catur-asre sampūjyāḥ || Parks_6.29 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Gaṃ</s>' <s>Gaṇapati</s>, '<s>Duṃ</s>' <s>Durgā</s>, '<s>Baṃ</s>' <s>Baṭuka</s>, '<s>Kṣaṃ</s>' <s>Kṣetrapāla</s> — these should be worshiped in the square.

children.text: sāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ, iti-prabhṛti, vāstu-pataye brahmaṇe namaḥ iti-paryantaṃ punas tatraivâbhyarcya || Parks_6.30 ||
children.translated_text: Beginning with '<s>Sāṃ Sarasvatyai namaḥ</s>' up to '<s>Vāstupataye Brahmaṇe namaḥ</s>' — one should worship again in that very place.

children.text: haṃsamūrti-paraprakāśa-pūrṇa-nitya-karuṇa-sampradāya-gurūṃś catur-asra-pūrva-rekhāyām abhyarcya || Parks_6.31 ||
children.translated_text: One should worship the lineage <s>Gurus</s> — of the <s>Haṃsamūrti</s>, <s>Paraprakāśa</s>, <s>Pūrṇa</s>, <s>Nitya</s>, <s>Karuṇā</s>, and <s>Sampradāya</s> traditions — on the eastern line of the square.

children.text: sva-śirasi sāmānya-viśeṣa-pāduke abhyarcayet || Parks_6.32 ||
children.translated_text: One should worship the general and specific <s>pādukas</s> (sacred sandals) upon one's own head.

children.text: punar devīm abhyarcya bālayā ṣoḍaśopacārān vidhāya || Parks_6.33 ||
children.translated_text: Having worshiped the <s>Devī</s> again, one should perform the sixteen services with the <s>Bālā</s> <s>mantra</s>.

children.text: śuddha-jalena tri-koṇa-vṛtta-catur-asraṃ vidhāyârdhânna-pūrṇa-salilaṃ sâdimopādima-madhyamaṃ su-[sa]-gandha-puṣpaṃ sâdhāraṃ pātraṃ nidhāya || Parks_6.34 ||
children.translated_text: With pure water, having formed the triangle, circle, and square, placing the vessel half-filled with water and food, with the first, supplementary, and middle offerings, with fragrant flowers, with the support.

children.text: śrī-mātam uktvā gîśvarîmaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa huṃ phaṭ svāhā śrī-mātam uktvā gîśvari śaraṇâgataṃ māṃ trāhi trāhi huṃ phaṭ svāhā kṣetra-pāla-nāthemaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa phaṭ svāhā - iti mantra-trayeṇa vāma-pārṣṇi-ghāta-karâsphoṭa-samudañcita-vaktra-nārāca-mudrābhiḥ baliṃ pradāya || Parks_6.35 ||
children.translated_text: Having uttered '<s>Śrīmāta</s>' — '<s>Gīśvarī</s>, accept, accept this offering, <s>huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>' — having uttered '<s>Śrīmāta</s>' — '<s>Gīśvarī</s>, protect, protect me who has taken refuge, <s>huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>' — '<s>Kṣetrapālanātha</s>, accept, accept this offering, <s>phaṭ svāhā</s>' — with these three <s>mantras</s>, with the left-heel-strike, hand-clap, mouth-upturning, and arrow <s>mudrās</s>, one should offer the <s>bali</s> (offering).

children.text: śyāmalāṃ śaktim āhūya bālayā tām abhyarcya tasyā hasta ādimopādimau dattvā tattvaṃ śodhayitvā tac-cheṣam urarīkṛtya yogyaiḥ saha haviś-śeṣaṃ svīkuryāt || Parks_6.36 ||
children.translated_text: Having invoked <s>Śyāmalā Śakti</s>, worshiping her with the <s>Bālā</s> <s>mantra</s>, having given her the first and supplementary offerings, purifying the <s>tattvas</s>, taking the remainder as consecrated, one should partake of the remainder of the oblation together with those who are worthy.

children.text: evaṃ nitya-saparyāṃ kurvan lakṣa-japaṃ japtvā tad-daśâṃśa-krameṇa ca homa-tarpaṇa-brāhmaṇa-bhojanāni vidadhyāt || Parks_6.37 ||
children.translated_text: Thus performing the daily worship, having completed a hundred thousand recitations, one should perform <s>homa</s> (fire ritual), <s>tarpaṇa</s> (libation), and feeding of brahmins, each at a tenth of the previous.

children.text: etan-manu-jāpī na kadambaṃ chindyāt girā kālîti na vadet vīṇā-veṇu-nartana-gāyana-gāthā-goṣṭhīṣu na parāṅ-mukho gacchet gāyakaṃ na nindyāt || Parks_6.38 ||
children.translated_text: The reciter of this <s>mantra</s> should not cut the <s>kadamba</s> tree; should not utter the word '<s>Kālī</s>' aloud; should not turn away from gatherings of <s>vīṇā</s>-playing, flute-playing, dancing, singing, and story-telling; and should not disparage a singer.

children.text: lalitopāsako nekṣu-khaṇḍaṃ bhakṣayet - na divā smared vārtālīṃ - na jugupseta siddha-dravyāṇi - na kuryāt strīṣu niṣṭhuratāṃ - vīra-striyaṃ na gacchet - na taṃ hanyāt - na tad-dravyam apaharet - nâtmecchayā ma-pañcakam urarīkuryāt - kula-bhraṣṭaiḥ saha nâsīta - na bahu pralapet - yoṣitaṃ sambhāṣamāṇām apratisambhāṣamāṇo na gacchet - kula-pustakāni gopāyet - iti śivam || Parks_6.39 ||
children.translated_text: The worshiper of <s>Lalitā</s> should not eat sugarcane pieces; should not remember <s>Vārtālī</s> during the day; should not feel disgust toward <s>siddha</s>-substances; should not be harsh toward women; should not approach a heroic woman; should not kill her; should not steal her property; should not accept the five <s>ma-s</s> of one's own accord; should not sit with those fallen from the tradition; should not prattle excessively; and while conversing with a woman...

children.text: 7. Khaṇḍa: Vārāhī-krama
children.translated_text: 7. Section: The <s>Vārāhī</s> Procedure (<s>Vārāhī-krama</s>)

children.text: itthaṃ sâṅgāṃ saṅgīta-mātṛkām iṣṭvā saṃvit-sāmrājñī-siṃhâsanâdhirūḍhāyā lalitāyā mahā-rājñyā daṇḍa-nāyikā-sthānīyāṃ duṣṭa-nigraha-śiṣṭânugraha-nirargalâjñā-cakrāṃ samaya-saṅketāṃ kola-mukhīṃ vidhivad varivasyet || Parks_7.1 ||
children.translated_text: Having thus worshiped the Mother of Music (<s>Saṅgītamātṛkā</s>) with all her limbs, one should duly attend upon <s>Kolamukhī</s> (Boar-Faced), who occupies the position of commander-in-chief of <s>Lalitā</s>, the great queen seated upon the throne of sovereign consciousness (<s>Saṃvit</s>) — she who wields unrestricted authority to subdue the wicked and favor the righteous, who bears the conventions of the tradition.

children.text: tatrâyaṃ kramo mahārātre buddhvā sva-hṛdaya-paramâkāśe dhvanantam anāhata-dhvanim ūrjitânanda-dāyakam avamṛśya || Parks_7.2 ||
children.translated_text: The procedure for this is: at the great night (<s>mahārātra</s>), having awakened, meditating in the supreme space of one's own heart upon the unstruck sound (<s>anāhatadhvani</s>) that resounds and bestows vigorous bliss —

children.text: śivâdi-śrī-gurubhyo namaḥ - iti mūrdhni badhnīyād añjalim || Parks_7.3 ||
children.translated_text: Saying '<s>Śivādi-śrī-gurubhyo namaḥ</s>' (Homage to the auspicious <s>Gurus</s> beginning with <s>Śiva</s>), one should bind the <s>añjali</s> (palms together) upon the head.

children.text: vācam uccārya glaum - iti ca paddhatāv asyāṃ sarve manavo japyāḥ || Parks_7.4 ||
children.translated_text: Having uttered the speech and '<s>glauṃ</s>' — in this procedure all <s>mantras</s> should be recited.

children.text: mūlâdi-ṣaṇ-mantraiḥ yathā-mantraṃ liṅga-dehaṃ śodhayet || Parks_7.5 ||
children.translated_text: With the six <s>mantras</s> beginning with the root, one should purify the subtle body (<s>liṅgadeha</s>) according to each <s>mantra</s>.

children.text: mūla-śṛṅgāṭakāt suṣumnā-pathena jīva-śivaṃ para-śive yojayāmi svāhā - yaṃ saṅkoca-śarīraṃ śoṣaya śoṣaya svāhā - raṃ saṅkoca-śarīraṃ [209] daha daha paca paca svāhā - vaṃ parama-śivâmṛtaṃ varṣaya varṣaya svāhā - laṃ śāmbhava-śarīram utpādayotpādaya svāhā - haṃsaḥ so 'ham avatarâvatara śiva-padāt jīva suṣumnā-pathena praviśa mūla-śṛṅgāṭakam ullasollasa jvala jvala prajvala prajvala haṃsaḥ so 'haṃ svāhā - iti bhūta-śuddhiṃ vidhāya || Parks_7.6 ||
children.translated_text: From the root junction (<s>mūla-śṛṅgāṭaka</s>), through the path of <s>suṣumnā</s>, 'I unite the individual soul (<s>jīva</s>) with <s>Śiva</s> in <s>Paraśiva</s>, <s>svāhā</s>' — '<s>yaṃ</s>, dry up, dry up the contracted body, <s>svāhā</s>' — '<s>raṃ</s>, burn, burn, cook, cook the contracted body, <s>svāhā</s>' — '<s>vaṃ</s>, shower, shower the nectar of <s>Paramaśiva</s>, <s>svāhā</s>' — '<s>laṃ</s>, produce, produce the <s>Śāmbhava</s> body, <s>svāhā</s>' — '<s>haṃsaḥ so'ham</s>, descend, descend from the station of <s>Śiva</s>, O <s>jīva</s>, enter through the path of <s>suṣumnā</s> into the root junction, shine forth, shine forth, blaze, blaze, blaze forth, blaze forth, <s>haṃsaḥ so'haṃ svāhā</s>' — thus having performed the <s>bhūta-śuddhi</s> (elemental purification). [Parks 7.6]

children.text: mātṛkā-sampuṭitāṃ dvitārīṃ kânanavṛtta-dvy-akṣi-śruti-nāsā-gaṇḍoṣṭha-danta-mūrdhâsya-doḥ-patsandhyagra-pārśva-dvaya-pṛṣṭha-nābhi-jaṭhara-hṛd-dormūlâparagala-kakṣa-hṛd-ādi-pāṇi-pāda-yugala-jaṭharânaneṣu - vinyasya || Parks_7.7 ||
children.translated_text: Having placed the second <s>Tārā</s> (<s>dvitārī</s>) enclosed by the <s>mātṛkā</s> (mother-letters) on the face-circle, two eyes, ears, nose, cheeks, lips, teeth, crown, face, arms, feet, joints, tips, both sides, back, navel, belly, heart, upper arms, lower neck, armpits, heart and so forth, pair of hands, pair of feet, belly, and face. [Parks 7.7]

children.text: andhe-prabhṛti saptârṇa-pañcakam aṅguṣṭhâdi-kaniṣṭhântam || Parks_7.8 ||
children.translated_text: Beginning with '<s>andhe</s>' and so forth, the five groups of seven syllables, from the thumb to the little finger. [Parks 7.8]

children.text: vāṅ namo bhagavatîty ārabhya trayodaśabhir hṛdayaṃ, ṣaḍbhiḥ śiraḥ, daśabhiḥ śikhāṃ, saptabhiḥ saptabhiḥ saptabhiḥ kavaca-netrâstrāṇi, vinyasya || Parks_7.9 ||
children.translated_text: Beginning with '<s>vāṃ namo bhagavatī</s>,' having placed thirteen [syllables] on the heart, six on the head, ten on the topknot (<s>śikhā</s>), and seven, seven, seven on the armor (<s>kavaca</s>), eye (<s>netra</s>), and weapon (<s>astra</s>). [Parks 7.9]

children.text: gandhâdibhir alaṅkṛtya arghyaṃ śodhayet || Parks_7.10 ||
children.translated_text: Having adorned with perfume and the like, one should purify the <s>arghya</s> (offering-water). [Parks 7.10]

children.text: ātmano 'gra-bhāge go-mayena vilipte, hetu-miśrita-jalena catur-asraṃ vartulaṃ ṣaṭ-koṇaṃ tri-koṇaṃ antarântaraṃ - vilikhya, arghya-śodhana-manubhiḥ śyāmā-kramoktaiḥ ādhārârghya-pātrāṇi saṃśodhya, sāmānyenâbhyarcya, tad arghyaṃ vaṣaḍ ity uddhṛtya, svāheti saṃsthāpya, huṃ - ity avakuṇṭhya, vauṣaṭ ity amṛtīkṛtya, phaḍ iti saṃrakṣya, namaḥ - iti puṣpaṃ nikṣipya, mūlena nirīkṣya, tat-pṛṣataiḥ pāvayitvā saparyā-vastūni || Parks_7.11 ||
children.translated_text: In front of oneself, on a surface smeared with cow-dung, having drawn with water mixed with substances a square, a circle, a hexagon, and a triangle one within another, having purified the base <s>arghya</s> vessels with the <s>arghya</s>-purification <s>mantras</s> as prescribed in the <s>Śyāmā</s> sequence, having worshiped them in general, having raised that <s>arghya</s> with '<s>vaṣaṭ</s>,' having established it with '<s>svāhā</s>,' having covered it with '<s>huṃ</s>,' having made it immortal with '<s>vauṣaṭ</s>,' having protected it with '<s>phaṭ</s>,' having cast a flower with '<s>namaḥ</s>,' having gazed upon it with the root <s>mantra</s>, and having purified the worship-implements with its drops. [Parks 7.11]

children.text: (1) śiro-vadana-hṛd-guhya-pādeṣu pūrvokta-saptaka-pañcakaṃ vinyasya (2) vidyām aṣṭadhā khaṇḍayitvā, pādâdi-jānu-jānv-ādi-kaṭi-kaṭy-ādi-nābhi-nābhy-ādi-hṛdaya-hṛdayâdi-kaṇṭha-kaṇṭhâdi-bhrūmadhya-bhrūmadhyâdi-lalāṭa-lalāṭâdi-mauliṣu ekatriṃśat sapta sapta sapta sapta sapta pañcatriṃśad ekādaśârṇa-khaṇḍān (3) mātṛkā-sthāneṣu mūla-manu-padāni ca nyasya || Parks_7.12 ||
children.translated_text: (1) Having placed the previously mentioned group of seven and group of five on the head, face, heart, private parts, and feet; (2) having divided the <s>vidyā</s> into eight parts, [placing] thirty-one, seven, seven, seven, seven, seven, thirty-five, and eleven syllable-sections on the [stations] from feet to knees, knees to waist, waist to navel, navel to heart, heart to throat, throat to brow-center, brow-center to forehead, and forehead to crown; (3) having placed the <s>mātṛkā</s> on their stations and the words of the root <s>mantra</s>. [Parks 7.12]

children.text: pūrvoktān aṣṭa-khaṇḍān ekaikaśa uccārya pūrvokteṣu sthāneṣu hlāṃ śarvāya kṣiti-tattvâdhipataye, hlīṃ bhavāya ambu-tattvâdhipataye, hlūṃ rudrāya vahni-tattvâdhipataye, hlaiṃ ugrāya vāyu-tattvâdhipataye, hlauṃ īśānāya bhānu-tattvâdhipataye, soṃ mahādevāya soma-tattvâdhipataye, haṃ mahādevāya yajamāna-tattvâdhipataye, auṃ bhīmāya ākāśa-tattvâdhipataye namaḥ - iti tattva-nyāsaḥ || Parks_7.13 ||
children.translated_text: Having uttered the previously mentioned eight sections one by one, in the aforementioned stations: '<s>hlāṃ</s>, to <s>Śarva</s>, lord of the earth-principle (<s>kṣiti-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>'; '<s>hlīṃ</s>, to <s>Bhava</s>, lord of the water-principle (<s>ambu-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>'; '<s>hlūṃ</s>, to <s>Rudra</s>, lord of the fire-principle (<s>vahni-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>'; '<s>hlaiṃ</s>, to <s>Ugra</s>, lord of the wind-principle (<s>vāyu-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>'; '<s>hlauṃ</s>, to <s>Īśāna</s>, lord of the sun-principle (<s>bhānu-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>'; '<s>soṃ</s>, to <s>Mahādeva</s>, lord of the moon-principle (<s>soma-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>'; '<s>haṃ</s>, to <s>Mahādeva</s>, lord of the sacrificer-principle (<s>yajamāna-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>'; '<s>auṃ</s>, to <s>Bhīma</s>, lord of the space-principle (<s>ākāśa-tattva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>' — thus is the <s>tattva-nyāsa</s> (placement of principles). [Parks 7.13]

children.text: mūlena sarveṇa vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā devīṃ dhyātvā || Parks_7.14 ||
children.translated_text: Having performed the pervasion (<s>vyāpaka</s>) with the entire root <s>mantra</s>, one should meditate upon the Goddess. [Parks 7.14]

children.text: purataḥ paṭa-paṭṭa-suvarṇa-rajata-tāmra-candana-pīṭhâdi-nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭi-manoharaṃ catur-asra-traya-sahasra-patra-śata-patrâṣṭa-patra-ṣaḍ-asra-pañcâsra-try-asra-bindu-lakṣaṇaṃ kola-mukhī-cakraṃ viracya || Parks_7.15 ||
children.translated_text: In front, having constructed the <s>Kolamukhī Cakra</s> (diagram) — fashioned on cloth, wooden board, gold, silver, copper, sandalwood, or a pedestal, delightful to behold — bearing the marks of a square, a thousand-petaled [lotus], a hundred-petaled, an eight-petaled, a hexagon, a pentagon, a triangle, and a <s>bindu</s> (point). [Parks 7.15]

children.text: tatra kusumâñjaliṃ vikīrya svarṇa-prākārāya sudhā-'bdhaye varāha-dvīpāya varāha-pīṭhāya namaḥ iti | āṃ - ādhāra-śaktaye, kuṃ kūrmāya, kaṃ kandāya, aṃ - ananta-nālāya namaḥ - iti ca dharmâdibhiḥ saha ṣoḍaśa-mantraiḥ pīṭhe abhyarcya || Parks_7.16 ||
children.translated_text: Therein, having scattered a handful of flowers: 'To the golden rampart, to the ocean of nectar, to <s>Varāha-dvīpa</s> (Boar Island), to the <s>Varāha-pīṭha</s> (Boar Seat), <s>namaḥ</s>.' '<s>āṃ</s>, to <s>Ādhāra-śakti</s> (the Supporting Power); <s>kuṃ</s>, to <s>Kūrma</s> (the Tortoise); <s>kaṃ</s>, to the Bulb (<s>kanda</s>); <s>aṃ</s>, to <s>Ananta-nāla</s> (the Infinite Stalk), <s>namaḥ</s>' — and having worshiped the seat (<s>pīṭha</s>) with the sixteen <s>mantras</s> together with <s>Dharma</s> and the others. [Parks 7.16]

children.text: tri-pañca-ṣaḍ-ara-dalâṣṭaka-śata-sahasrâra-padmâsanāya namaḥ - iti cakra-manunā cakram iṣṭvā || Parks_7.17 ||
children.translated_text: 'To the lotus-seat with three, five, six spokes, eight petals, hundred, and thousand spokes, <s>namaḥ</s>' — having worshiped the <s>cakra</s> with the <s>cakra-mantra</s>. [Parks 7.17]

children.text: vahni-maṇḍalāya sūrya-maṇḍalāya soma-maṇḍalāya namaḥ - iti trayo guṇa-mantrāḥ - ātma-mantrāḥ catvāraḥ - iti saptaviṃśatikam idaṃ pīṭhe varivasanīyam || Parks_7.18 ||
children.translated_text: 'To the fire-<s>maṇḍala</s>, to the sun-<s>maṇḍala</s>, to the moon-<s>maṇḍala</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' — these are the three <s>guṇa-mantras</s>; the four <s>ātma-mantras</s> — thus these twenty-seven [items] should be worshiped on the seat (<s>pīṭha</s>). [Parks 7.18]

children.text: hauṃ preta-padmâsanāya sadāśivāya namaḥ - iti cakropari devy-āsana-vimṛṣṭiḥ || Parks_7.19 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>hauṃ</s>, to the Corpse-Lotus Seat (<s>preta-padmāsana</s>), to <s>Sadāśiva</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' — thus is the contemplation of the Goddess's seat above the <s>cakra</s>. [Parks 7.19]

children.text: ḹ ṣā ī vārāhī-mūrtaye ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ huṃ phaṭ - iti, vāg-glaum-ādi-glauṃ-vāg-antā, mūrti-karaṇī, vidyā || Parks_7.20 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>ḹ ṣā ī</s>, to the <s>Vārāhī</s> form, <s>ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ huṃ phaṭ</s>' — thus, beginning with <s>vāg-glaum</s> and ending with <s>glauṃ-vāg</s>, is the <s>mūrti-karaṇī vidyā</s> (form-producing sacred formula). [Parks 7.20]

children.text: mūla-vidyayā āvāhana-saṃsthāpana-saṃnidhāpana-saṃnirodhana-sammukhīkaraṇâvakuṇṭhana-vandana-dhenu-yonīr baddhvā || Parks_7.21 ||
children.translated_text: Having formed the <s>mudrās</s> of invocation (<s>āvāhana</s>), establishment (<s>saṃsthāpana</s>), making present (<s>saṃnidhāpana</s>), confinement (<s>saṃnirodhana</s>), turning to face (<s>sammukhīkaraṇa</s>), covering (<s>avakuṇṭhana</s>), salutation (<s>vandana</s>), <s>dhenu</s>, and <s>yoni</s> with the root <s>vidyā</s>. [Parks 7.21]

children.text: devy-aṅga-nyasta-ṣaḍ-aṅga-pañcâṅgaḥ || Parks_7.22 ||
children.translated_text: Having the six-limb and five-limb [<s>nyāsa</s>] placed on the Goddess's limbs. [Parks 7.22]

children.text: pādyârghyâcamanīya-snāna-vāso-gandha-puṣpa-dhūpa-dīpa-nīrājana-chatra-cāmara-darpaṇa-rakṣâcamanīya-naivedya-pānīya-tāmbūlâkhya-ṣoḍaśopacāra-kḷpty-ante || Parks_7.23 ||
children.translated_text: At the conclusion of the sixteen services (<s>ṣoḍaśopacāra</s>) — namely: foot-water (<s>pādya</s>), <s>arghya</s>, mouth-rinsing water (<s>ācamanīya</s>), bathing (<s>snāna</s>), garments (<s>vāsa</s>), perfume (<s>gandha</s>), flowers (<s>puṣpa</s>), incense (<s>dhūpa</s>), lamp (<s>dīpa</s>), waving of lights (<s>nīrājana</s>), parasol (<s>chatra</s>), fly-whisk (<s>cāmara</s>), mirror (<s>darpaṇa</s>), protection (<s>rakṣā</s>), mouth-rinsing water (<s>ācamanīya</s>), food-offering (<s>naivedya</s>), drink (<s>pānīya</s>), and betel (<s>tāmbūla</s>). [Parks 7.23]

children.text: dhyānaṃ devyāḥ - megha-mecakā kuṭila-daṃṣṭrā kapila-nayanā, ghana-stana-maṇḍalā cakra-khaḍga-musalâbhaya-śaṅkha-kheṭa-hala-vara-pāṇiḥ padmâsīnā vārtālī dhyeyā || Parks_7.24 ||
children.translated_text: The meditation (<s>dhyāna</s>) of the Goddess: <s>Vārtālī</s> should be meditated upon as dark as a cloud, with curved fangs, tawny-eyed, with massive breasts, holding in her hands a discus (<s>cakra</s>), sword (<s>khaḍga</s>), mace (<s>musala</s>), gesture of fearlessness (<s>abhaya</s>), conch (<s>śaṅkha</s>), shield (<s>kheṭa</s>), plough (<s>hala</s>), and boon-granting [gesture] (<s>vara</s>), seated on a lotus. [Parks 7.24]

children.text: daśadhā tasyās tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt || Parks_7.25 ||
children.translated_text: One should perform the <s>tarpaṇa</s> (libation) for her tenfold. [Parks 7.25]

children.text: try-asre jambhinī-mohinī-stambhinyaḥ || Parks_7.26 ||
children.translated_text: In the triangle: <s>Jambhinī</s>, <s>Mohinī</s>, and <s>Stambhinī</s>. [Parks 7.26]

children.text: pañcâre andhinī-rundhinyau tāś ca || Parks_7.27 ||
children.translated_text: On the five spokes: <s>Andhinī</s> and <s>Rundhinī</s>, and those [three]. [Parks 7.27]

children.text: ṣaṭ-koṇe ā kṣā ī brahmāṇī, ī lā ī māheśvarī, ū hā ī kaumārī, ṝ sā ī vaiṣṇavī, ai śā ī indrāṇī, au vā ī cāmuṇḍā tasyaivâgreṣu madhye ca ya-ma-ra-yūṃ yāṃ yīṃ yūṃ yaiṃ yauṃ yaḥ yākini jambhaya jambhaya mama sarva-śatrūṇāṃ tvag-dhātuṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa aṇimā-''di-vaśaṃ kuru kuru svāheti | anyāsāṃ dhātu-nāthānām apy evaṃ bīje nāmani dhātau tv ārādhana-karmaṇi mantra-sannāmaḥ | ra-ma-ra-yūṃ rākiṇi rakta-dhātuṃ piba piba la-ma-ra-yūṃ lākini māṃsa-dhātuṃ bhakṣaya bhakṣaya ḍa-ma-ra-yūṃ ḍākini medo-dhātuṃ grasa grasa ka-ma-ra-yūṃ kākini asthi-dhātuṃ jambhaya jambhaya sa-ma-ra-yūṃ sākini majjā-dhātuṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa ha-ma-ra-yūṃ hākini śukra-dhātuṃ piba piba aṇimā-''di-vaśaṃ kuru kuru svāhā - iti dhātu-nātha-yajanam || Parks_7.28 ||
children.translated_text: In the hexagon: '<s>ā kṣā ī</s>, <s>Brahmāṇī</s>'; '<s>ī lā ī</s>, <s>Māheśvarī</s>'; '<s>ū hā ī</s>, <s>Kaumārī</s>'; '<s>ṝ sā ī</s>, <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>'; '<s>ai śā ī</s>, <s>Indrāṇī</s>'; '<s>au vā ī</s>, <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s>' — at their tips and in the center: '<s>ya-ma-ra-yūṃ yāṃ yīṃ yūṃ yaiṃ yauṃ yaḥ</s>, <s>Yākinī</s>, paralyze, paralyze, seize, seize the skin-tissue of all my enemies, grant, grant [me] mastery of <s>aṇimā</s> and the other [powers], <s>svāhā</s>.' For the other tissue-lords (<s>dhātu-nātha</s>) likewise, [changing] the seed-syllable, name, and tissue, but the propitiation and action in the <s>mantra</s> [are the same]: '<s>ra-ma-ra-yūṃ</s>, <s>Rākinī</s>, drink, drink the blood-tissue'; '<s>la-ma-ra-yūṃ</s>, <s>Lākinī</s>, devour, devour the flesh-tissue'; '<s>ḍa-ma-ra-yūṃ</s>, <s>Ḍākinī</s>, swallow, swallow the fat-tissue'; '<s>ka-ma-ra-yūṃ</s>, <s>Kākinī</s>, crush, crush the bone-tissue'; '<s>sa-ma-ra-yūṃ</s>, <s>Sākinī</s>, seize, seize the marrow-tissue'; '<s>ha-ma-ra-yūṃ</s>, <s>Hākinī</s>, drink, drink the semen-tissue; grant mastery of <s>aṇimā</s> and the others, <s>svāhā</s>' — thus is the worship of the tissue-lords. [Parks 7.28]

children.text: anantaraṃ ṣaḍ-asrobhaya-pārśvayoḥ krodhinī-stambhinyau cāmara-grāhiṇyau tatraiva stambhana-musalâyudhāya ākarṣaṇa-halâyudhāya namaḥ ṣaḍ-arād bahiḥ purato devyāḥ kṣrauṃ krauṃ caṇḍoccaṇḍāya namaḥ - iti tad-yajanam || Parks_7.29 ||
children.translated_text: Next, on both sides of the hexagon: <s>Krodhinī</s> and <s>Stambhinī</s>, holding fly-whisks; there also: 'To the one with the mace-weapon of paralysis, <s>namaḥ</s>'; 'To the one with the plough-weapon of attraction, <s>namaḥ</s>.' Outside the hexagon, in front of the Goddess: '<s>kṣrauṃ krauṃ</s>, to <s>Caṇḍoccaṇḍa</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' — thus is its worship. [Parks 7.29]

children.text: aṣṭa-dale vārtālī-vārāhī-varāhamukhy-andhiny-ādayaḥ pañca tad-bahiḥ mahā-mahiṣāya devī-vāhanāya namaḥ || Parks_7.30 ||
children.translated_text: On the eight petals: <s>Vārtālī</s>, <s>Vārāhī</s>, <s>Varāhamukhī</s>, <s>Andhinī</s>, and the others — [making] five; outside that: 'To <s>Mahāmahiṣa</s> (the Great Buffalo), the vehicle of the Goddess, <s>namaḥ</s>.' [Parks 7.30]

children.text: (1) śatâre devī-purato dala-sandhau jambhinyā indrāyâpsarobhyaḥ siddhebhyo dvādaśâdityebhyo 'gnaye sādhyebhyo viśvebhyo devebhyo viśvakarmaṇe yamāya mātṛbhyo rudra-paricārakebhyo rudrebhyo mohinyai nirṛtaye rākṣasebhyo mitrebhyo gandharvebhyo bhūta-gaṇebhyo varuṇāya vasubhyo vidyā-dharebhyaḥ [221] kinnarebhyo vāyave stambhinyai citra-rathāya tumburave nāradāya yakṣebhyaḥ somāya kuberāya devebhyo viṣṇave īśānāya brahmaṇe aśvibhyāṃ dhanvantaraye vināyakebhyo namaḥ - iti devatā-maṇḍalam iṣṭvā (2) tad-bahiḥ auṃ kṣauṃ kṣetra-pālāya namaḥ, siṃha-varāya devī-vāhanāya namaḥ - iti ca tad ubhayaṃ varivasyet | tad-bahiḥ mahā-kṛṣṇāya mṛga-rājāya devī-vāhanāya namaḥ - iti tat-pūjā || Parks_7.31 ||
children.translated_text: (1) On the hundred-spoked [section], in front of the Goddess, at the junctions of the petals: 'To <s>Jambhinī</s>; to <s>Indra</s>; to the <s>Apsarases</s>; to the <s>Siddhas</s>; to the twelve <s>Ādityas</s>; to <s>Agni</s>; to the <s>Sādhyas</s>; to the <s>Viśvedevas</s>; to <s>Viśvakarman</s>; to <s>Yama</s>; to the <s>Mātṛs</s> (Mothers); to the attendants of <s>Rudra</s>; to the <s>Rudras</s>; to <s>Mohinī</s>; to <s>Nirṛti</s>; to the <s>Rākṣasas</s>; to <s>Mitra</s>; to the <s>Gandharvas</s>; to the <s>Bhūta-gaṇas</s> (hosts of spirits); to <s>Varuṇa</s>; to the <s>Vasus</s>; to the <s>Vidyādharas</s>; to the <s>Kinnaras</s>; to <s>Vāyu</s>; to <s>Stambhinī</s>; to <s>Citraratha</s>; to <s>Tumburu</s>; to <s>Nārada</s>; to the <s>Yakṣas</s>; to <s>Soma</s>; to <s>Kubera</s>; to the <s>Devas</s>; to <s>Viṣṇu</s>; to <s>Īśāna</s>; to <s>Brahman</s>; to the two <s>Aśvins</s>; to <s>Dhanvantari</s>; to the <s>Vināyakas</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' — thus having worshiped the deity-<s>maṇḍala</s>. (2) Outside that: '<s>auṃ kṣauṃ</s>, to <s>Kṣetrapāla</s> (the Field-Protector), <s>namaḥ</s>'; 'To <s>Siṃhavara</s> (the Lion), the vehicle of the Goddess, <s>namaḥ</s>' — and one should worship both of those. Outside that: 'To <s>Mahākṛṣṇa</s> (the Great Dark One), the king of beasts, the vehicle of the Goddess, <s>namaḥ</s>' — thus is his worship. [Parks 7.31]

children.text: (1) sahasrâre aṣṭadhā vibhakte airāvatāya puṇḍarīkāya vāmanāya kumudāyâñjanāya puṣpa-dantāya sārvabhaumāya supratīkāya namaḥ - iti tat-pūjā bahiḥ sudhā-'bdher vā | (2) bāhya-prākārâṣṭa-dikṣu adha upari ca hetukâdayaḥ, bhairava-kṣetra-pāla-śabda-yuktāḥ pratyekaṃ kṣaum-ādayaś ca yaṣṭavyāḥ | hetuka-tripurântakâgni-yamajihvaikapāda-kāla-karāla-bhīmarūpa-hāṭakeśâcalāḥ daśa bhairavāḥ || Parks_7.32 ||
children.translated_text: (1) On the thousand-spoked [section], divided into eight: 'To <s>Airāvata</s>, <s>Puṇḍarīka</s>, <s>Vāmana</s>, <s>Kumuda</s>, <s>Añjana</s>, <s>Puṣpadanta</s>, <s>Sārvabhauma</s>, and <s>Supratīka</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' — thus is their worship, or outside the ocean of nectar. (2) On the eight directions, below, and above the outer rampart: <s>Hetuka</s> and the others, each combined with the words '<s>Bhairava</s>' and '<s>Kṣetrapāla</s>,' along with '<s>kṣauṃ</s>' and so forth, should be worshiped. The ten <s>Bhairavas</s> are: <s>Hetuka</s>, <s>Tripurāntaka</s>, <s>Agni</s>, <s>Yamajihva</s>, <s>Ekapāda</s>, <s>Kāla</s>, <s>Karāla</s>, <s>Bhīmarūpa</s>, <s>Hāṭakeśa</s>, and <s>Acala</s>. [Parks 7.32]

children.text: evaṃ ṣaḍ-āvaraṇīm iṣṭvā punar devīṃ tridhā santarpya sarvair upacārair upacarya || Parks_7.33 ||
children.translated_text: Having thus worshipped the six enclosures, again satisfying the <s>Devī</s> three times and serving her with all the <s>upacāras</s> (services).

children.text: purato vāma-bhāge hasta-mātraṃ jalenopalipya rudhirânna-haridrā-'nna-mahiṣa-pala-saktu-śarkarā-hetu-phala-traya-mākṣika-mudga-traya-māṣa-cūrṇa-dadhi-kṣīra-ghṛtaiḥ śuddhodanaṃ sammardya caraṇâyudhâṇḍa-pramāṇān daśa-piṇḍān vidhāya tatra nidhāya kapittha-phala-mānam ekaṃ piṇḍaṃ ca tat-samīpe sâdimopādima-madhyamaṃ caṣakaṃ ca nikṣipya daśa-piṇḍān hetukâdibhyo madhyama-piṇḍaṃ caṣakaṃ ca caṇḍoccaṇḍāya tat-tan-mantraiḥ datvā vṛndam ārādhya || Parks_7.34 ||
children.translated_text: Before [the practitioner], to the left side, smearing an area the size of a hand with water, kneading pure rice with blood-rice, turmeric-rice, buffalo meat, barley flour, sugar, three types of <s>hetu</s>-fruit, honey, three types of green gram, black gram powder, yogurt, milk, and ghee, making ten balls the size of a foot, weapon, and egg, placing them there; and placing one ball the size of a wood-apple fruit and a cup with the first, last, and middle portions near it; giving the ten balls to <s>Hetukā</s> etc., and the middle ball and cup to <s>Caṇḍoccaṇḍa</s> with their respective <s>mantras</s>, worshipping the assembly.

children.text: yathā-vibhavaṃ śrī-guruṃ saṃtoṣya || Parks_7.35 ||
children.translated_text: Satisfying the glorious <s>Guru</s> according to one's means.

children.text: sampūrṇa-yauvanāḥ sa-lakṣaṇā-madanonmādinīs tisraḥ śaktīr āhūya baṭukaṃ caikam abhyarcya snapayitvā gandhâdibhir alaṅkṛtya vārtālī-buddhyā ekāṃ śaktiṃ madhye krodhinī-stambhinī-buddhyā dve itare pārśvayoś caṇḍoccaṇḍa-dhiyā baṭukam agre sthāpayitvā sarvair dravyaiḥ saṃtoṣya mama śrī-vārtālī-mantra-siddhir bhūyād iti tāḥ prativadet tāś ca prasīdantv adhidevatāḥ - iti brūyuḥ || Parks_7.36 ||
children.translated_text: Inviting three <s>śaktis</s> who are of full youth, bearing auspicious marks, maddening with desire; and worshipping one <s>baṭuka</s>; bathing them and adorning them with sandalwood paste etc.; placing one <s>śakti</s> in the center with the understanding of <s>Vārtālī</s>, the two others on either side with the understanding of <s>Krodhinī</s> and <s>Stambhinī</s>, and the <s>baṭuka</s> in front with the understanding of <s>Caṇḍoccaṇḍa</s>; satisfying them with all substances; one should declare to them 'may <s>Śrī Vārtālī mantra-siddhi</s> (perfection of the mantra) come to me'; and they should reply 'may the presiding deities be pleased.'

children.text: evaṃ sa-parivārām udārāṃ bhūdāra-vadanām upatoṣya lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yad-daśâṃśaṃ tāpiccha-kusumair hutvā mantraṃ sādhayet || Parks_7.37 ||
children.translated_text: Having thus propitiated the generous boar-faced one with her retinue, performing one hundred thousand preliminary recitations, and offering oblations with <s>tāpiccha</s> (Calotropis) flowers at a tenth of that, one should accomplish the <s>mantra</s>.

children.text: tataś ca pūjitāṃ devīm ātmani yojayitvā svairaṃ viharann ājñā-siddhaḥ sukhī viharet - iti śivam || Parks_7.38 ||
children.translated_text: Then, having united the worshipped <s>Devī</s> into oneself, one of accomplished command should dwell happily, moving about at will. Thus, auspiciousness.

children.text: 8. Khaṇḍa: Parā-krama
children.translated_text: Chapter 8: <s>Parā-krama</s> (The Procedure of the Supreme)

children.text: iti vidhivat kṛta-vārtālī-varivasyaḥ siṃhâsana-vidyā-hṛdayam anuttaraṃ parā-bīja-rūpaṃ dhāma tat-krama-pūrvaṃ vimṛśet || Parks_8.1 ||
children.translated_text: Having thus duly completed the worship of <s>Vārtālī</s>, one should contemplate, preceded by its procedure, the unsurpassed radiance in the form of the <s>Parā-bīja</s> (Supreme Seed), which is the heart of the <s>Siṃhāsana-vidyā</s> (Throne Knowledge).

children.text: prabhu-hṛdaya-jñātuḥ pade pade sukhāni bhavanti || Parks_8.2 ||
children.translated_text: For one who knows the heart of the sovereign, happiness arises at every step.

children.text: atho 'nuttara-paddhatiṃ vyākhyāsyāmāḥ || Parks_8.3 ||
children.translated_text: Now we shall expound the unsurpassed procedure.

children.text: kalye samutthāya brahma-koṭara-vartini sahasra-dala-kamale sanniviṣṭāyāḥ sauvarṇa-rūpāyāḥ parāyāś caraṇa-yugala-vigalad-amṛta-rasa-visara-pariplutaṃ vapuḥ dhyātvā || Parks_8.4 ||
children.translated_text: Rising early in the morning, meditating upon the body as flooded by the flowing stream of nectar descending from the pair of feet of <s>Parā</s>, who is of golden form, seated upon the thousand-petaled lotus residing in the hollow of <s>Brahman</s> (the fontanelle).

children.text: snātaḥ śuci-vāso-vasānaḥ, sauḥ-varṇena trir ācamya, dviḥ parimṛjya, sakṛd upaspṛśya, cakṣuṣī, nāsike, śrotre, aṃse, nābhiṃ, hṛdayaṃ, śiraś câvamṛśya, evaṃ trir ācamya || Parks_8.5 ||
children.translated_text: Having bathed, wearing pure garments, sipping water three times with the syllable 'sauḥ,' wiping twice, touching [the lips] once, touching the eyes, nostrils, ears, shoulders, navel, heart, and head — thus sipping three times.

children.text: ūrṇā-mṛdu-śucitamam āsanaṃ sau-varṇa-sūrya-japâbhimantritaṃ mūla-mantrokṣitam adhiṣṭhāya || Parks_8.6 ||
children.translated_text: Sitting upon a seat of the softest and purest wool, consecrated by recitation of the 'sauḥ'-syllable solar <s>japa</s> and sprinkled with the root mantra.

children.text: udag-vadano maunī bhūṣita-vigraho mūla-pūrveṇa deśika-manunā mastake deśikam iṣṭvā || Parks_8.7 ||
children.translated_text: Facing north, observing silence, with adorned body, worshipping the <s>Guru</s> (Teacher) upon the crown of the head with the <s>deśika-manu</s> (teacher's mantra) preceded by the root.

children.text: vāma-pārṣṇi-ghātaiḥ choṭikā-trayeṇa pātālâdi-gatān bhedâvabhāsinaḥ vighnān utsārya || Parks_8.8 ||
children.translated_text: Expelling the obstacles that manifest as divisions, dwelling from the nether realms upward, by striking the left heel and snapping the fingers three times.

children.text: śiro-mukha-hṛn-mūla-sarvâṅgeṣu mūlaṃ vinyasya || Parks_8.9 ||
children.translated_text: Placing the root mantra on the head, face, heart, root center, and all limbs.

children.text: kāka-cañcūpuṭâkṛtinā mukhena saṃcoṣyânilaṃ saptaviṃśatiśo mūlaṃ japtvā vedyaṃ nābhau saṃmudrya punaḥ saptaviṃśatiśo japtvā aṅguṣṭhena śikhāṃ badhvā punar anilam āpūrya tena mūle cid-agnim utthāpya tatra vedyasya vilayaṃ vibhāvya || Parks_8.10 ||
children.translated_text: Drawing in the breath with the mouth formed like a crow's beak, reciting the root mantra twenty-seven times, sealing the offering in the navel; again reciting twenty-seven times, binding the topknot with the thumb; again filling with the breath, raising the fire of consciousness at the root with it, and contemplating the dissolution of the offering therein.

children.text: gomayenopalipta-catur-asra-bhū-tale pravahat-pārśva-kara-kṛtayā matsya-mudrayā divya-gandhâmbu-yutayā bhū-vyoma-vāyu-vahni-maṇḍalāni kṛtvā || Parks_8.11 ||
children.translated_text: On a square ground-surface smeared with cow-dung, making the <s>maṇḍalas</s> (circles) of earth, space, wind, and fire with the fish <s>mudrā</s> formed by the hands with flowing sides.

children.text: śyāmā-vat sāmānya-viśeṣârghye sādayet || Parks_8.12 ||
children.translated_text: As in the <s>Śyāmā</s> [procedure], one should prepare the general and specific <s>arghya</s> (offerings).

children.text: sarve 'pi parā-krama-manavaḥ sauḥ varṇa-pūrvāḥ kāryāḥ || Parks_8.13 ||
children.translated_text: All the mantras of the <s>Parā-krama</s> should be preceded by the syllable 'sauḥ.'

children.text: bhṛgu-caturdaśa-ṣoḍaśa-dvir-āvṛtyā, varṇa-ṣaḍ-aṅgaṃ sarva-mūla-ṣaḍ-āvṛtyā, mantra-ṣaḍ-aṅgaṃ ca, kṛtvā || Parks_8.14 ||
children.translated_text: Performing the <s>bhṛgu</s> (brow-point), the fourteen, and the sixteen, each repeated twice; the <s>varṇa-ṣaḍaṅga</s> (syllable six-limbs) with the totality of the root repeated six times; and the <s>mantra-ṣaḍaṅga</s> (mantra six-limbs).

children.text: ubhābhyām arcayitvā || Parks_8.15 ||
children.translated_text: Worshipping with both [the general and specific arghyas].

children.text: mūlam uccārya, tāṃ cinmayīm ānanda-lakṣaṇām amṛta-kalaśa-piśita-hasta-dvayāṃ, prasannāṃ, devīṃ, pūjayāmi namaḥ svāhā - iti sudhā-devīm abhyarcya tayā samprokṣya varivasyā--vastūni || Parks_8.16 ||
children.translated_text: Uttering the root mantra, 'I worship the <s>Devī</s>, she who is of the nature of pure consciousness, characterized by bliss, holding a vessel of nectar and flesh in both hands, serene — pūjayāmi namaḥ svāhā' — thus worshipping <s>Sudhā-devī</s> (the Goddess of Nectar), and sprinkling the implements of worship with her.

children.text: pūrvaṃ nābhau sammudritaṃ cid-agni-vilīnaṃ taptâyo-drava-vat ṣaṭtriṃśat-tattva-kadambakaṃ hṛt-saroje samānīya || Parks_8.17 ||
children.translated_text: Bringing to the heart-lotus the cluster of thirty-six <s>tattvas</s> (principles), previously sealed in the navel and dissolved in the fire of consciousness, [now flowing] like molten heated iron.

children.text: mūla-japtaiḥ kusuma-kṣepaiḥ vakṣyamāṇaiś ca mantrair āsana-kḷptiṃ kuryāt - mūlâdi-yoga-pīṭhāya namaḥ - ity antāni tāni ca pṛthivy-ap-tejo-vāyv-ākāśa-gandha-rasa-rūpa-sparśa-śabdopastha-pāyu-pāda-pāṇi-vāg-ghrāṇa-jihvā-cakṣus-tvak-śrotrâ- [243] haṅkāra-buddhi-manaḥ-prakṛti-puruṣa-niyati-kāla-rāga-kalâvidyā-māyā-śuddhavidyeśvara-sadāśiva-śakti-śivāḥ | evaṃ parā-cakraṃ kṛtvā || Parks_8.18 ||
children.translated_text: One should construct the seat with flower-offerings consecrated by root-mantra recitation and with the mantras to be stated — 'Homage to the yoga-seat beginning with the root' — those ending [mantras] being: earth, water, fire, wind, space, smell, taste, form, touch, sound, generative organ, excretory organ, feet, hands, speech, nose, tongue, eyes, skin, ears, ego, intellect, mind, <s>Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature), <s>Puruṣa</s> (consciousness), <s>Niyati</s> (regulation), <s>Kāla</s> (time), <s>Rāga</s> (attachment), <s>Kalā</s> (limited agency), <s>Avidyā</s> (ignorance), <s>Māyā</s> (illusion), <s>Śuddhavidyā</s> (pure knowledge), <s>Īśvara</s> (Lord), <s>Sadāśiva</s>, <s>Śakti</s> (Power), and <s>Śiva</s>. Having thus constructed the <s>Parā-cakra</s>.

children.text: tatraitad-aikya-vimarśa-rūpiṇīṃ ṣoḍaśa-kalāṃ parāṃ devīm āvāhya || Parks_8.19 ||
children.translated_text: There, invoking the Supreme <s>Devī</s> of sixteen <s>kalās</s>, who is of the form of the reflection of the unity of this [cakra].

children.text: akalaṅka-śaśâṅkâbhā try-akṣā candra-kalā-vatī |
children.translated_text: She of spotless moonlike radiance, three-eyed, adorned with the crescent moon,

children.text: mudrā-pusta-lasad-bāhuḥ pātu māṃ, paramā kalā ||
children.translated_text: Her arms resplendent with <s>mudrā</s> and book — may the Supreme <s>Kalā</s> protect me.

children.text: iti dhyātvā || Parks_8.20 ||
children.translated_text: Thus meditating.

children.text: mūlâdim uccārya prakāśa-rūpiṇī parā-bhaṭṭārikā, mūla-madhyam uccārya vimarśa-rūpiṇī parā-bhaṭṭārikā, mūlântyam uccārya prakāśa-vimarśa-rūpiṇī parā-bhaṭṭāriketi tribhiḥ devyā mūla-hṛn-mukheṣv abhyarcya samastam uccārya, mahā-prakāśa-vimarśa-rūpiṇī parā-bhaṭṭāriketi, daśavāram avamṛśya tām eva devīṃ, kālâgni-koṭi-dīptāṃ dhyātvā || Parks_8.21 ||
children.translated_text: Uttering the first part of the root mantra, 'She is <s>Parā-Bhaṭṭārikā</s> (the Supreme Sovereign) of the form of Illumination'; uttering the middle of the root, 'She is <s>Parā-Bhaṭṭārikā</s> of the form of Reflection'; uttering the end of the root, 'She is <s>Parā-Bhaṭṭārikā</s> of the form of Illumination and Reflection' — with these three, worshipping the <s>Devī</s> at the root, heart, and mouth [centers]; uttering the complete [mantra], 'She is <s>Parā-Bhaṭṭārikā</s> of the form of Great Illumination and Reflection' — touching [the mantra] ten times, meditating upon that very <s>Devī</s> as blazing with the brilliance of ten million fires of the end of time.

children.text: tasyāṃ kriyā-samabhivyāhāreṇa vedyam akhilaṃ hutvā || Parks_8.22 ||
children.translated_text: Into her, by the concurrent expression of ritual action, offering all that is to be known as an oblation.

children.text: mūlam uccārya, sāmānya-pādukayā sva-mastaka-sthāya gurave arghyaṃ nivedya || Parks_8.23 ||
children.translated_text: Uttering the root mantra, presenting <s>arghya</s> (offering) to the <s>Guru</s> stationed upon one's own crown with the general <s>pādukā</s> (mantra).

children.text: punaś cid-agnim uddīptaṃ vibhāvya || Parks_8.24 ||
children.translated_text: Again contemplating the fire of consciousness blazing brightly.

children.text: divyaughaṃ tisraḥ pādukāḥ siddhaughaṃ tisraḥ mānavaugham aṣṭāv abhyarcya || Parks_8.25 ||
children.translated_text: Worshipping three <s>pādukās</s> (sacred sandals) of the divine lineage, three of the <s>siddha</s> (perfected) lineage, and eight of the human lineage.

children.text: parābhaṭṭārikā-'ghora-śrīkaṇṭha-śaktidhara-krodha-tryambakânanda-pratibhādevyambā, vīrasaṃvidānanda-madhurādevyambā, jñāna-śrīrāma-yogāḥ - iti, parā-krama-pādukāḥ || Parks_8.26 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Parā-Bhaṭṭārikā</s>-<s>Aghoraśrīkaṇṭha</s>-<s>Śaktidhara</s>-<s>Krodha</s>-<s>Tryambaka</s>-<s>Ānandapratibhā-Devyambā</s>, <s>Vīra-Saṃvid-Ānanda-Madhurā-Devyambā</s>, <s>Jñāna</s>-<s>Śrīrāma</s>-<s>Yoga</s> — these are the <s>pādukās</s> of the <s>Parā-krama</s>.

children.text: tataḥ kalā-manunā baliṃ nivedya || Parks_8.27 ||
children.translated_text: Then, offering the <s>bali</s> (offering) with the <s>kalā</s>-mantra.

children.text: haviś-śeṣam ātma-sātkuryāt | iti śivam || Parks_8.28 ||
children.translated_text: One should absorb the remainder of the oblation into oneself. Thus, auspiciousness.

children.text: 9. Khaṇḍa: Homa--vidhi
children.translated_text: Chapter 9: <s>Homa-vidhi</s> (The Procedure of the Fire Ritual)

children.text: atha sveṣṭa-mantrasya homa-vidhānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || Parks_9.1 ||
children.translated_text: Now we shall expound the procedure of the fire ritual for one's chosen <s>mantra</s>.

children.text: catur-asraṃ kuṇḍam athavā hastâyāmam aṅguṣṭhonnataṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā || Parks_9.2 ||
children.translated_text: Making a square fire-pit, or alternatively a hearth one hand-span long and one thumb-breadth high.

children.text: sāmānyârghyam upaśodhya tenâvokṣya || Parks_9.3 ||
children.translated_text: Purifying the general <s>arghya</s> and sprinkling with it.

children.text: prācīr udīcīs tisras tisro rekhā likhitvā || Parks_9.4 ||
children.translated_text: Drawing three lines eastward and three northward.

children.text: tāsu rekhāsu brahma-yama-soma-rudra-viṣṇv-indrān, ṣaṭtārī-namas-sampuṭitān abhyarcya || Parks_9.5 ||
children.translated_text: On those lines, worshipping <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Yama</s>, <s>Soma</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Indra</s>, enclosed with six <s>tārīs</s> (mantric syllables) and 'namaḥ.'

children.text: sahasrârciṣe hṛdayāya namaḥ, svasti-pūrṇāya śirase svāhā, uttiṣṭha puruṣāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ, dhūma-vyāpine kavacāya huṃ, sapta-jihvāya netra-trayāya vauṣaṭ, dhanur-dharāya astrāya phaṭ - iti ṣaḍ-aṅgaṃ vidhāya tena ṣaḍ-aṅgena kuṇḍam abhyarcya || Parks_9.6 ||
children.translated_text: 'To the thousand-rayed one, homage to the heart; to the one filled with auspiciousness, svāhā to the head; to the rising <s>Puruṣa</s> (Cosmic Person), vaṣaṭ to the topknot; to the smoke-pervading one, huṃ to the armor; to the seven-tongued one, vauṣaṭ to the three eyes; to the bow-bearer, phaṭ to the weapon' — thus performing the <s>ṣaḍaṅga</s> (six limbs) and worshipping the fire-pit with those six limbs.

children.text: tatrâṣṭa-koṇa-ṣaṭ-koṇa-tri-koṇâtmakaṃ agni-cakraṃ vilikhya pītāyai śvetāyai aruṇāyai kṛṣṇāyai dhūmrāyai tīvrāyai sphuliṅginyai rucirāyai jvālinyai nama iti tri-koṇa-madhye vahneḥ pīṭha-śaktīḥ sampūjya - taṃ tamase, raṃ rajase, saṃ sattvāya, ām ātmane, am antarātmane, paṃ paramâtmane, hrīṃ jñānâtmane namaḥ - iti tatraivâbhyarcayet || Parks_9.7 ||
children.translated_text: There, drawing the fire-diagram consisting of an octagon, hexagon, and triangle; worshipping the seat-<s>śaktis</s> of the fire in the middle of the triangle — 'Homage to <s>Pītā</s> (the Yellow), <s>Śvetā</s> (the White), <s>Aruṇā</s> (the Red), <s>Kṛṣṇā</s> (the Black), <s>Dhūmrā</s> (the Smoky), <s>Tīvrā</s> (the Fierce), <s>Sphuliṅginī</s> (the Sparking), <s>Rucirā</s> (the Brilliant), <s>Jvālinī</s> (the Blazing)'; 'taṃ to <s>Tamas</s> (darkness), raṃ to <s>Rajas</s> (passion), saṃ to <s>Sattva</s> (purity), āṃ to the <s>Ātman</s> (Self), aṃ to the <s>Antarātman</s> (Inner Self), paṃ to the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self), hrīṃ to the <s>Jñānātman</s> (Knowledge-Self), namaḥ' — thus one should worship therein.

children.text: tato janiṣyamāṇa-vahneḥ pitarau vāgīśvarī-vagīśvarau pīṭhe 'bhyarcya tayor mithunībhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā hrīṃ vāgīśvarī-vāgīśvarābhyāṃ namaḥ - iti dhyātvā || Parks_9.8 ||
children.translated_text: Then, worshipping the parents of the fire about to be born — <s>Vāgīśvarī</s> (the Goddess of Speech) and <s>Vāgīśvara</s> (the Lord of Speech) — upon the seat, contemplating their union, meditating with 'hrīṃ, homage to <s>Vāgīśvarī</s> and <s>Vāgīśvara</s>.'

children.text: araṇeḥ sūrya-kāntāt dvija-gṛhād vā vahnim utpādya mṛt-pātre tāmra-pātre vā āgneyyām aiśānyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ vā nidhāya, agni-śakalaṃ krāvyādâṃśaṃ nairṛtyāṃ visārya nirīkṣaṇa-prokṣaṇa-tāḍanâvakuṇṭhanâdibhiḥ viśodhya [248] oṃ vaiśvānara jātaveda ihâvaha lohitâkṣa sarva-karmāṇi sādhaya svāhā - iti mūlâdhārodgata-saṃvidaṃ lalāṭa-netra-dvārā nirgamayya taṃ bāhyâgni-yuktaṃ pātayet || Parks_9.9 ||
children.translated_text: Having produced fire from an <s>araṇi</s> (fire-churning stick), a <s>sūryakānta</s> (sun-stone/crystal lens), or from a brahmin's house, and having placed it in an earthen vessel or copper vessel in the southeast, northeast, or southwest direction, one should cast away the cremation-fire portion (<s>krāvyāda</s>-portion) to the southwest, and purify [the fire] by gazing, sprinkling, striking, and covering, etc. [Then reciting:] "Oṃ, O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, bring [the offerings] here, O red-eyed one, accomplish all rites, <s>svāhā</s>" — thus one should cause the <s>saṃvid</s> (consciousness) arisen from the <s>mūlādhāra</s> (root center) to exit through the forehead-eye passage, and unite it with the external fire, letting it descend.

children.text: kavaca-mantreṇa indhanair ācchādya || Parks_9.10 ||
children.translated_text: One should cover [the fire] with fuel-sticks while reciting the <s>kavaca-mantra</s> (armor mantra).

children.text: agniṃ prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutâśanam |
children.translated_text: I salute the blazing fire, <s>Jātavedas</s>, the devourer of oblations,

children.text: suvarṇa-varṇam analaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvato-mukham ||
children.translated_text: Golden-hued, flaming, well-kindled, facing all directions —

children.text: ity upasthāya || Parks_9.11 ||
children.translated_text: thus having reverently approached [the fire].

children.text: uttiṣṭha harita-piṅgala lohitâkṣa sarva-karmāṇi sādhaya me dehi dāpaya svāhā - iti vahnim utthāpya || Parks_9.12 ||
children.translated_text: "Arise, O green-and-tawny one, O red-eyed one, accomplish all rites, give to me, cause [others] to give, <s>svāhā</s>" — thus one should raise the fire.

children.text: cit-piṅgala hana hana daha daha paca paca sarva-jñâjñāpaya svāhā, iti prajvālya || Parks_9.13 ||
children.translated_text: "O <s>Cit-piṅgala</s> (tawny consciousness), destroy, destroy, burn, burn, cook, cook, command the all-knowing one, <s>svāhā</s>" — thus one should cause [the fire] to blaze forth.

children.text: ṣaṭtāra-vāco namo-mantreṇa puṃsavana-sīmanta-jātakarma-nāmakaraṇânnaprāśana-caulopanayana-godāna-vivāha-karmāṇy amukâgner amukaṃ karma kalpayāmi namaḥ - iti vidhāya || Parks_9.14 ||
children.translated_text: With the <s>namas</s>-mantra of the six-pointed star formula, one should perform [the sacraments]: <s>puṃsavana</s> (male-generating rite), <s>sīmanta</s> (parting-of-hair rite), <s>jātakarma</s> (birth rite), <s>nāmakaraṇa</s> (naming ceremony), <s>annaprāśana</s> (first-feeding rite), <s>caula</s> (tonsure), <s>upanayana</s> (sacred thread investiture), <s>godāna</s> (gift of cattle/first shaving), and <s>vivāha</s> (marriage) — [saying] "For such-and-such fire, I ordain such-and-such rite, <s>namaḥ</s>" — thus one should perform [these rites for the fire].

children.text: pariṣicya paristīrya paridhāya || Parks_9.15 ||
children.translated_text: Having sprinkled around, having strewn [grass] around, and having placed the enclosing sticks,

children.text: tri-ṇayanam aruṇâbhaṃ baddha-mauliṃ suśuklâṃ-
children.translated_text: Three-eyed, dawn-colored, with bound crest, clad in brilliant white,

children.text: śukam aruṇam anekâkalpam ambhoja-saṃstham |
children.translated_text: a parrot, reddish, with manifold ornaments, seated on a lotus,

children.text: abhimata-vara-śakti-svastikâbhīti-hastaṃ
children.translated_text: holding in his hands a desired boon-granting <s>śakti</s> (power/spear), <s>svastika</s>, and <s>abhīti</s> (gesture of fearlessness),

children.text: namata kanaka-mālâlaṅkṛtâṃsaṃ kṛśânum ||
children.translated_text: bow to <s>Kṛśānu</s> (Fire), adorned with a garland of gold on his shoulders —

children.text: iti dhyātvā || Parks_9.16 ||
children.translated_text: thus having meditated [on the fire deity].

children.text: (1) aṣṭa-koṇe jātavedase sapta-jihvāya havya-vāhāya aśvodarāya vaiśvānarāya kaumāra-tejase viśva-mukhāya deva-mukhāya namaḥ - iti (2) ṣaṭ-koṇe ṣaḍ-aṅgaṃ (3) tri-koṇe agni-mantreṇa agniṃ pūjayitvā || Parks_9.17 ||
children.translated_text: In the eight-pointed [figure, one should worship with]: "To <s>Jātavedas</s>, to the seven-tongued one, to the oblation-carrier, to <s>Aśvodara</s>, to <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, to <s>Kaumāra-tejas</s>, to <s>Viśvamukha</s>, to <s>Devamukha</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>" — thus (1) in the eight-angled [figure]; (2) in the six-angled [figure], the six ancillary [deities]; (3) in the triangle, one should worship <s>Agni</s> with the <s>Agni</s>-mantra.

children.text: hiraṇyāyai kanakāyai raktāyai kṛṣṇāyai suprabhāyai atiraktāyai bahu-rūpāyai namaḥ - ity agneḥ sapta-jihvāsu mūla-śuddhenâjyena saptâhutīḥ kuryāt || Parks_9.18 ||
children.translated_text: "To <s>Hiraṇyā</s> (the golden one), to <s>Kanakā</s> (the gold-bright one), to <s>Raktā</s> (the red one), to <s>Kṛṣṇā</s> (the dark one), to <s>Suprabhā</s> (the radiant one), to <s>Atiraktā</s> (the deeply red one), to <s>Bahurūpā</s> (the many-formed one), <s>namaḥ</s>" — thus upon the seven tongues of <s>Agni</s>, one should offer seven oblations of ghee purified with the root-mantra.

children.text: vaiśvānarottiṣṭha-cit-piṅgalair agnes tridhā ''hutiṃ vidhāya || Parks_9.19 ||
children.translated_text: Having performed the threefold oblation into the fire with the <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, <s>Uttiṣṭha</s>, and <s>Cit-piṅgala</s> [mantras],

children.text: bahu-rūpa-jihvāyām iṣṭāṃ devatām āvāhya pañcopacārair upacarya || Parks_9.20 ||
children.translated_text: one should invoke the desired deity upon the <s>Bahurūpā</s> (many-formed) tongue, and attend [the deity] with the five offerings (<s>pañcopacāra</s>).

children.text: sarvāsāṃ cakra-devīnām ekâhutiṃ hutvā, namo-'ntān pādukā-'ntān śeṣān mantrān svāhā-'ntān vidhāya juhuyāt || Parks_9.21 ||
children.translated_text: Having offered a single oblation for all the deities of the <s>cakra</s> (mystic diagram), one should convert the remaining mantras ending in <s>namaḥ</s> and those ending in <s>pādukā</s> into mantras ending in <s>svāhā</s>, and offer [them as oblations].

children.text: atha pradhāna-devatāyai daśâhutīr juhuyāt || Parks_9.22 ||
children.translated_text: Then one should offer ten oblations to the principal deity.

children.text: yadi kāmyam īpsed abhīṣṭa-devatāyai vijñāpya saṅkalpaṃ kṛtvaitāvat-karma-siddhy-artham etāvad-āhutīḥ kariṣyāmîti || Parks_9.23 ||
children.translated_text: If one desires a specific wish, one should inform the desired deity, make a <s>saṅkalpa</s> (solemn resolve), [saying]: "For the accomplishment of such-and-such rite, I shall offer so many oblations."

children.text: tilâjyaiḥ śāntyā - annenânnāyâmṛtāya - samic-cūta-pallavair jvara-śamāya - dūrvābhir āyuṣe - kṛta-mālair dhanāyotpalair bhāgāya - bilva-dalai rājyāya - padmaiḥ [252] sāmrājyāya - śuddha-lājaiḥ kanyāyai - nandy-āvartaiḥ kavitvāya - vañjulaiḥ puṣṭayai - mallikā-jātī-punnāgair bhāgyāya - bandhūka-japā-kiṃśuka-bakula-madhukarair aiśvaryāya - lavaṇair ākarṣaṇāya - kadambaiḥ sarva-vaśyāya - śāli-taṇḍulair dhānyāya - kuṅkuma-gorocanâdi-sugandhaiḥ saubhāgyāya - palāśa-puṣpaiḥ kapilā-ghṛtair vā tejase - dhattūra-kusumair unmādāya - viṣa-vṛkṣaiḥ nimba-śleṣmātaka-vibhītaka-samidbhiḥ śatru-nāśāya - nimba-tailâkta-lavaṇair māraṇāya - kākolūka-pakṣair vidveṣaṇāya - tila-tailâkta-marīcaiḥ kāsa-śvāsa-nāśāya - juhuyāt || Parks_9.24 ||
children.translated_text: One should offer oblations: with sesame and ghee for <s>śānti</s> (peace); with food for [the mantra] "to <s>Anna</s> (food), to the immortal"; with <s>samit</s> (sacrificial sticks) and mango sprouts for the alleviation of fever; with <s>dūrvā</s> grass for longevity; with rosaries of <s>kṛta</s> for wealth, with blue lotuses for fortune; with <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) leaves for sovereignty; with lotuses for supreme sovereignty; with pure parched rice for [obtaining] a maiden; with <s>nandyāvarta</s> [flowers] for poetic gift; with <s>vañjula</s> [flowers] for nourishment; with <s>mallikā</s> (jasmine), <s>jātī</s> (wild jasmine), and <s>punnāga</s> (Calophyllum) for good fortune; with <s>bandhūka</s>, <s>japā</s> (hibiscus), <s>kiṃśuka</s> (flame-of-the-forest), <s>bakula</s>, and <s>madhukara</s> (honey-flowers) for lordly power; with salt for attraction; with <s>kadamba</s> flowers for universal subjugation; with unhusked rice grains for abundance of grain; with saffron, <s>gorocanā</s>, and other fragrant substances for auspiciousness; with <s>palāśa</s> (Butea) flowers or with the ghee of a tawny cow for splendor; with <s>dhattūra</s> (datura) blossoms for causing madness; with poisonous trees — <s>nimba</s> (neem), <s>śleṣmātaka</s>, and <s>vibhītaka</s> fire-sticks — for destruction of enemies; with salt smeared with neem oil for killing; with the feathers of crows and owls for creating enmity; with black pepper smeared with sesame oil for destruction of cough and asthma.

children.text: baliṃ pradāya || Parks_9.25 ||
children.translated_text: Having offered the <s>bali</s> (sacrificial offering),

children.text: oṃ bhūr agnaye ca pṛthivyai ca mahate ca svāhā |
oṃ bhuvo vāyave cântarikṣāya ca mahate ca svāhā |
children.translated_text: "Oṃ <s>Bhuvaḥ</s>! To <s>Vāyu</s> (Wind), to <s>Antarikṣa</s> (Atmosphere), and to the Great One, <s>svāhā</s>!"

children.text: oṃ suvar ādityāya ca dive ca mahate ca svāhā |
children.translated_text: "Oṃ <s>Suvaḥ</s>! To <s>Āditya</s> (Sun), to <s>Div</s> (Heaven), and to the Great One, <s>svāhā</s>!"

children.text: oṃ bhūr bhuvas suvaś candramase ca nakṣatrebhyaś ca digbhyaś ca mahate ca svāhā |
children.translated_text: "Oṃ <s>Bhūr Bhuvas Suvaḥ</s>! To <s>Candramā</s> (Moon), to the <s>Nakṣatras</s> (stars), to the cardinal directions, and to the Great One, <s>svāhā</s>!"

children.text: iti caturbhir mantraiḥ mahā-vyāhṛti-homaṃ kṛtvā || Parks_9.26 ||
children.translated_text: Thus, having performed the <s>mahā-vyāhṛti-homa</s> (great utterances fire-oblation) with these four mantras,
"Oṃ <s>Bhūḥ</s>! To <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Pṛthivī</s> (Earth), and to the Great One, <s>svāhā</s>!"

children.text: itaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇa-buddhi-deha-dharmâdhikārato jāgrat-svapna-suṣupty-avasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padbhyām udareṇa śiśnā yat smṛtaṃ yad uktaṃ [254] yat kṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ brahmârpaṇaṃ bhavatu svāhā, iti brahmârpaṇâhutiṃ kṛtvā || Parks_9.27 ||
children.translated_text: "Whatever before this, by reason of <s>prāṇa</s> (vital breath), intellect, body, and dharmic capacity, in the states of waking, dreaming, and deep sleep, by mind, by speech, by action, by hands, by feet, by belly, by generative organ — whatever was remembered, whatever was uttered, whatever was done — may all that become an offering to <s>Brahman</s>, <s>svāhā</s>" — thus having made the <s>brahmārpaṇa</s> oblation (offering unto <s>Brahman</s>),

children.text: cid-agniṃ devatāṃ câtmany udvāsayāmi namaḥ - ity udvāsya || Parks_9.28 ||
children.translated_text: "I dismiss the fire of consciousness (<s>cid-agni</s>) and the deity back into myself, <s>namaḥ</s>" — thus having dismissed [them].

children.text: tad-bhasma-tilaka-dharo loka-sammohana-kāraḥ sukhī viharet | iti śivam || Parks_9.29 ||
children.translated_text: Bearing the <s>tilaka</s> (forehead mark) of that ash, one who causes the enchantment of the world should live happily. Thus, auspiciousness.

children.text: 10. Khaṇḍa: Sarva-sādhāraṇa-krama
children.translated_text: 10. Section: The General Procedure for All [Mantras] (<s>Sarva-sādhāraṇa-krama</s>)

children.text: athâtaḥ sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ sāmānya-paddhatiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || Parks_10.1 ||
children.translated_text: Now, henceforth, we shall expound the common method (<s>sāmānya-paddhati</s>) for all mantras.

children.text: śyāmā-vat sandhyā-''dy-arghya-śodhana-paryantaṃ nyāsa-varjam || Parks_10.2 ||
children.translated_text: As in the <s>Śyāmā</s> [procedure], from the <s>sandhyā</s> (twilight worship) and other [preliminary rites] up to the <s>arghya</s> (water offering) and purification, excluding the <s>nyāsas</s> (ritual placements).

children.text: anukta-ṣaḍ-aṅgasya ṣaḍ-jāti-yukta-māyayā ṣaḍ-aṅgam || Parks_10.3 ||
children.translated_text: For [a mantra] whose six ancillaries (<s>ṣaḍaṅga</s>) are not specified, the six ancillaries [should be formed] by [adding] <s>Māyā</s> [bīja] conjoined with the six <s>jāti</s> [seed-syllables].

children.text: bindu-tri-ṣaḍ-ara-nāga-dala-catuṣ-patra-catur-asra-mayaṃ cakram || Parks_10.4 ||
children.translated_text: The <s>cakra</s> (mystic diagram) consists of a <s>bindu</s> (center point), triangle, hexagon, eight-petaled [lotus], four-petaled [lotus], and a square.

children.text: bindau mukhya-devatecchā-jñāna-kriyā-śaktayas try-asre, ṣaḍ-are tat-tat-ṣaḍ-aṅgāny aṣṭa-dale brāhmy-ādyāḥ, catur-dale gaṇapati-durgā-baṭuka-kṣetreśāś, catur-asre dik-pālāḥ || Parks_10.5 ||
children.translated_text: At the <s>bindu</s> — the chief deity, <s>Icchā</s> (will), <s>Jñāna</s> (knowledge), and <s>Kriyā</s> (action) <s>Śaktis</s> in the triangle; in the hexagon — the respective six ancillary [deities]; in the eight-petaled [lotus] — <s>Brāhmī</s> and the other [mātṛkās]; in the four-petaled [lotus] — <s>Gaṇapati</s>, <s>Durgā</s>, <s>Baṭuka</s>, and <s>Kṣetreśa</s>; in the square — the guardians of the directions.

children.text: tritārī-kumārībhyāṃ sarve krama-mantrāḥ prayoktavyāḥ || Parks_10.6 ||
children.translated_text: All sequential mantras (<s>krama-mantras</s>) should be employed with [the mantras of] <s>Tritārī</s> and <s>Kumārī</s>.

children.text: tat-tan-mūlenâvāhanaṃ kalā-manunā balir anena krameṇâhutiḥ || Parks_10.7 ||
children.translated_text: Invocation [is done] with the respective root [mantra]; the offering (<s>bali</s>) with the <s>kalā-manu</s>; the oblation (<s>āhuti</s>) in this order.

children.text: atha raśmi-mālā || Parks_10.8 ||
children.translated_text: Now, the <s>Raśmimālā</s> (Garland of Rays).

children.text: suptotthitenaiṣā manasaikavāram āvartyā || Parks_10.9 ||
children.translated_text: This should be recited mentally once upon waking from sleep.

children.text: (1) praṇavo bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ -
children.translated_text: "(1) <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), <s>Bhūr Bhuvas Suvaḥ</s> —

children.text: tat-savitur vareṇiyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
children.translated_text: We meditate upon that excellent radiance of the divine <s>Savitṛ</s>,

children.text: dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
children.translated_text: may he stimulate our thoughts."

children.text: iti triṃśad-varṇā gāyatrī ||
children.translated_text: This is the <s>Gāyatrī</s> of thirty syllables.

children.text: (2) yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kuru |
children.translated_text: "(2) From wherever we fear, O <s>Indra</s>, from that make us fearless;

children.text: maghavañ chagdhi tava tan na ūtaye vidviṣo vimṛdho jahi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maghavan</s> (bounteous one), be powerful for our protection, smite down those who hate us!

children.text: svasti-dā viśas-patir vṛtra-hā vimṛdho vaśī |
children.translated_text: May the bestower of well-being, the lord of peoples, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the subduer, the sovereign,
the bull among lords, go before us — the bestower of well-being, the remover of fear!"

children.text: vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ svasti-dā abhayaṅkaraḥ ||
ity aindrī saptaṣaṣṭy-arṇā saṅkaṭe bhaya-nāśinī ||
children.translated_text: This is the <s>Aindrī</s> [vidyā] of sixty-seven syllables, the destroyer of fear in times of danger.

children.text: (3) praṇavo ghṛṇis sūrya āditya ity aṣṭârṇā saurī tejo-dā ||
children.translated_text: "(3) <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), <s>Ghṛṇi</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Āditya</s>" — this is the <s>Saurī</s> [vidyā] of eight syllables, bestowing radiant energy.

children.text: (4) praṇavaḥ kevalo brahma-vidyā mukti-dā ||
children.translated_text: "(4) <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ) alone" — this is <s>Brahmavidyā</s> (knowledge of <s>Brahman</s>), the bestower of liberation.

children.text: (5) tāraḥ paro-rajase (')sāvad om iti navârṇā turya-gāyatrī svaikya-vimarśinī ||
children.translated_text: "(5) <s>Tāra</s> (Oṃ), beyond the rajas (darkness), that [supreme being], Oṃ" — this is the <s>Turya-gāyatrī</s> (fourth Gāyatrī) of nine syllables, which leads to the contemplation of one's identity with the Supreme.

children.text: raśmi-pañcakam etan-mūla-hṛt-phāla-vidhibila-dvādaśânta-bījatayā vimṛṣṭavyam || Parks_10.10 ||
children.translated_text: This fivefold garland of rays (<s>raśmi-pañcaka</s>) should be contemplated as the seed-syllables at the root (<s>mūla</s>), heart (<s>hṛt</s>), forehead (<s>phāla</s>), the ritual aperture (<s>vidhibili</s>), and the <s>dvādaśānta</s> (twelve-finger-breadths above the crown).

children.text: (1) sūryâkṣi-tejase namaḥ | (2) khecarāya namaḥ | (3) asato mā sad gamaya | (4) tamaso mā jyotir gamaya | (5) mṛtyor mā 'mṛtaṃ gamaya | (6) uṣṇo bhagavān śuci-rūpaḥ | (7) haṃso bhagavān śucir apratirūpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "(1) To the radiance of the sun-eyed one, <s>namaḥ</s>! (2) To the sky-wanderer (<s>Khecara</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>! (3) From the unreal lead me to the real! (4) From darkness lead me to light! (5) From death lead me to immortality! (6) The Lord is radiant, of pure form! (7) The Lord is the <s>Haṃsa</s> (supreme swan), pure, without equal!"

children.text: (8) viśva-rūpaṃ ghṛṇinaṃ jāta-vedasaṃ
children.translated_text: "(8) Him of universal form, radiant, <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: hiraṇ-mayaṃ jyotir ekaṃ tapantam |
children.translated_text: golden, the one light, blazing,

children.text: sahasra-raśmiḥ śatadhā vartamānaḥ
children.translated_text: the thousand-rayed one, manifesting in a hundredfold ways —

children.text: prāṇaḥ prajānām udayaty eṣa sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the life-breath of all creatures, this <s>Sūrya</s> (Sun) rises."
"(9) Oṃ, salutation to the blessed <s>Sūrya</s>! O bearer, O bearer, O bearer, O bearer, <s>svāhā</s>!"

children.text: (9) oṃ namo bhagavate sūryāya aho vāhini vāhiny aho vāhini vāhini svāhā ||
(10) vayas suparṇā upasedur indraṃ
children.translated_text: "(10) Like birds, the beautiful-winged ones, approached <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: priyamedhā ṛṣayo nātha-mānāḥ |
children.translated_text: the sages of holy wisdom, seeking protection;

children.text: apadhvāntam ūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣur
children.translated_text: dispel the darkness, fill [our] sight,

children.text: mumugdhy asmān nidhayeva baddhān ||
children.translated_text: release us, like those bound in a pit!"

children.text: (11) puṇḍarīkâkṣāya namaḥ | (12) puṣkarekṣaṇāya namaḥ | (13) amalekṣaṇāya namaḥ | (14) kamalekṣaṇāya namaḥ | (15) viśva-rūpāya namaḥ | (16) śrī-mahā-viṣṇave namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: "(11) To the lotus-eyed one (<s>Puṇḍarīkākṣa</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>! (12) To the lotus-gazed one (<s>Puṣkarekṣaṇa</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>! (13) To the pure-eyed one (<s>Amalekṣaṇa</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>! (14) To the lotus-eyed one (<s>Kamalekṣaṇa</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>! (15) To the one of universal form (<s>Viśvarūpa</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>! (16) To the glorious great <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>!"

children.text: iti ṣoḍaśa-mantra-samaṣṭi-rūpiṇī dūra-dṛṣṭi-pradā cākṣuṣmatī vidyā || Parks_10.11 ||
children.translated_text: This is the <s>Cākṣuṣmatī Vidyā</s> (Eye-power Knowledge), the collective form of sixteen mantras, which bestows far-seeing vision.

children.text: praṇavo gandharva-rāja viśvā-vaso mama abhilaṣitâmukāṃ kanyāṃ prayaccha tato 'gni-vallabhety uttama-kanyā-vivāha-dāyinī vidyā || Parks_10.12 ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), O king of <s>Gandharvas</s>, O <s>Viśvāvasu</s>, grant me the desired maiden named such-and-such, then [she shall be] beloved of <s>Agni</s>" — this is the <s>vidyā</s> that bestows marriage with the best maiden.

children.text: tāro namo rudrāya pathi-ṣade svasti mā sampāraya - iti mārga-saṅkaṭa-hāriṇī vidyā || Parks_10.13 ||
children.translated_text: "<s>Tāra</s> (Oṃ), salutation to <s>Rudra</s> who sits by the path — safely convey me across" — this is the <s>vidyā</s> that removes dangers on the road.

children.text: tāras tāre padam uktvā tuttāre ture śabdaṃ ca dahana-dayiteti jalâpac-chamanī vidyā || Parks_10.14 ||
children.translated_text: Having uttered the words '<s>tāras tāre</s>' [and then] '<s>tuttāre ture</s>' and '<s>dahana-dayitā</s>' (beloved of fire) — this is the <s>jalāpacchamanī vidyā</s> (the sacred formula that quenches water [i.e., fever]). [Parks 10.14]

children.text: acyutāya namaḥ, anantāya namaḥ, govindāya namaḥ - iti mahā-vyādhi-vināśinī nāma-trayī vidyā || Parks_10.15 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Acyutāya namaḥ</s>, <s>Anantāya namaḥ</s>, <s>Govindāya namaḥ</s>' — this is the triad of names, the <s>vidyā</s> called '<s>Mahāvyādhi-vināśinī</s>' (Destroyer of Great Disease). [Parks 10.15]

children.text: pañcemā raśmayo mūlâdi-parikaratayā prapañcyāḥ || Parks_10.16 ||
children.translated_text: These five rays (<s>raśmis</s>) should be elaborated as subsidiary to the root [<s>mantra</s>] and the others. [Parks 10.16]

children.text: praṇavaḥ kamalā bhuvanā madano glāc caturdaśa-pañcadaśau gaṃ gaṇapataye vara-yugalaṃ da sarva-janaṃ me śabdo vaśam ānayâgni-vāma-locaneti mahā-gaṇapati-vidyā pratyūha-śamanī || Parks_10.17 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), <s>Kamalā</s>, <s>Bhuvanā</s>, <s>Madana</s>, '<s>glā</s>' — the fourteenth and fifteenth [syllables] — '<s>gaṃ gaṇapataye</s>' — a pair of boons (<s>vara</s>) — '<s>da</s>' — 'bring all people under my' — the word '<s>vaśam ānaya</s>' (subjugation) — '<s>agni-vāma-locana</s>' (fire and left eye) — this is the <s>Mahāgaṇapati Vidyā</s> (Great <s>Gaṇapati</s> formula), the remover of obstacles (<s>pratyūha-śamanī</s>). [Parks 10.17]

children.text: praṇavo namaḥ śivāyai, praṇavo namaḥ śivāyeti dvādaśârṇā, śiva-tattva-vimarśinī vidyā || Parks_10.18 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ) <s>namaḥ Śivāyai</s>, <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ) <s>namaḥ Śivāya</s>' — this is the twelve-syllabled <s>vidyā</s>, the reflector of <s>Śiva-tattva</s> (<s>Śiva-tattva-vimarśinī</s>). [Parks 10.18]

children.text: praṇavaḥ kâṣṭama-dakṣa-śruti-bindu-piṇḍo bhṛgu-ṣoḍaśo māṃ pālaya-dvandvam iti daśârṇā mṛtyor api mṛtyur eṣā vidyā || Parks_10.19 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), '<s>ka</s>,' the eighth, '<s>dakṣa</s>,' '<s>śruti</s>,' <s>bindu</s>, <s>piṇḍa</s>, <s>bhṛgu</s>, the sixteenth, 'protect me' (doubled) — this is the ten-syllabled <s>vidyā</s>, the death even of death itself. [Parks 10.19]

children.text: tāraḥ namo brahmaṇe dhāraṇaṃ me astv anirā-karaṇaṃ dhārayitā bhūyāsaṃ karṇayoḥ śrutaṃ mâcyoḍhvaṃ mamâmuṣya oṃ - iti śruta-dhāriṇī vidyā || Parks_10.20 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Tāra</s> (Oṃ), '<s>namo Brahmaṇe</s>, may retention (<s>dhāraṇa</s>) be mine, may there be no rejection, may I be one who retains, may what has been heard by the ears not slip away, of me, of so-and-so, Oṃ' — this is the <s>Śruta-dhāriṇī Vidyā</s> (formula for retaining what is heard). [Parks 10.20]

children.text: śrīkaṇṭâdi-kṣântāḥ sarve varṇāḥ bindu-sahitāḥ mātṛkā sarva-jñatā-karī vidyā || Parks_10.21 ||
children.translated_text: All the <s>varṇas</s> (phonemes) from '<s>Śrīkaṇṭha</s>' onward to '<s>kṣa</s>,' each accompanied by <s>bindu</s> — [this is] the <s>Mātṛkā</s> (mother-syllabary), the <s>vidyā</s> that produces omniscience (<s>sarvajñatā-karī</s>). [Parks 10.21]

children.text: raśmayaḥ pañca mūlâdi-rakṣā-''tmakatayā yaṣṭavyāḥ || Parks_10.22 ||
