children.translated_text: The five rays (<s>raśmis</s>) should be worshiped as having the nature of protection, beginning with the root [<s>mantra</s>]. [Parks 10.22]

children.text: śiva-śakti-kāma-kṣiti-māyā-ravîndu-smara-haṃsa-purandara-bhuvanā-parā-manmatha-vāsava-bhauvanāś ca śivâdi-vidyā sva-svarūpa-vimarśinī || Parks_10.23 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Śakti</s>, <s>Kāma</s>, <s>Kṣiti</s>, <s>Māyā</s>, <s>Ravi</s> (Sun), <s>Indu</s> (Moon), <s>Smara</s>, <s>Haṃsa</s>, <s>Purandara</s>, <s>Bhuvanā</s>, <s>Parā</s>, <s>Manmatha</s>, <s>Vāsava</s>, <s>Bhauvanā</s> — and the <s>Śivādi Vidyā</s> (formula beginning with <s>Śiva</s>), which is the reflector of one's own essential nature (<s>sva-svarūpa-vimarśinī</s>). [Parks 10.23]

children.text: kla-śabdād vāmekṣaṇa-bindur eko 'nanta-yoni-bindavo 'nyaḥ śaṅkara-parā-triśūla-visṛṣṭayo 'paraś caita eva khaṇḍāḥ pratilomāḥ ṣaṭ-kūṭā sampat-karī vidyā || Parks_10.24 ||
children.translated_text: From the syllable '<s>kla</s>,' the <s>bindu</s> of the left eye — one [section]; the <s>bindus</s> of '<s>ananta</s>' and '<s>yoni</s>' — another; the <s>triśūla</s> (trident) emanations of <s>Śaṅkara</s> and <s>Parā</s> — yet another; these very sections in reverse order — the six peaks (<s>kūṭas</s>) constitute the <s>Sampatkarī Vidyā</s> (Prosperity-producing formula). [Parks 10.24]

children.text: sam uccārya sṛṣṭi-nitye svāheti ham ity uktvā sthiti-pūrṇe namaḥ - ity anala-bindu-mahā-saṃhāriṇī kṛśe padāc caṇḍa-śabdaḥ kāli phaṭ - ity agni-bindu-saptama-mudrā-bījaṃ mahā-nākhye ananta-bhāskari mahā-caṇḍa-padāt kāli phaṭ - iti sṛṣṭi-sthiti-saṃhārâkhyānāṃ prātilomyaṃ khecarī-bījaṃ mahā-caṇḍa-vāṇī ca yogîśvarîti vidyā-pañcaka-rūpiṇī kāla-saṅkarṣiṇī paramâyuḥ-pradāyinī || Parks_10.25 ||
children.translated_text: Having uttered '<s>sam</s>,' '<s>sṛṣṭi-nitye svāhā</s>' (O Eternal One of Creation, <s>svāhā</s>); having said '<s>ham</s>,' '<s>sthiti-pūrṇe namaḥ</s>' (O Complete One of Preservation, <s>namaḥ</s>); '<s>anala-bindu-mahā-saṃhāriṇī kṛśe</s>' (O Great Destroyer, O Emaciated One), from the word 'fierce' (<s>caṇḍa</s>), '<s>Kālī phaṭ</s>'; '<s>agni-bindu</s>,' the seventh <s>mudrā</s>-seed, '<s>mahā-nākhye</s>' (in the great named one), '<s>ananta-bhāskari</s>' (O Infinite Radiant One), from '<s>mahā-caṇḍa</s>' the word '<s>Kālī phaṭ</s>'; the reverse of those named Creation, Preservation, and Destruction; the <s>Khecarī</s>-seed and <s>Mahā-caṇḍa-vāṇī</s> (Great Fierce Speech) and <s>Yogīśvarī</s> — this is the <s>vidyā</s> in the form of a pentad, <s>Kālasaṅkarṣiṇī</s> (She who draws in Time), the bestower of supreme longevity. [Parks 10.25]

children.text: tritārī saptama-mudrā śiva-yuk-śaktir ahaṃ-yugalam etat-pañcaiva lomyam iti śuddha-jñāna-mayī śāmbhavī vidyā || Parks_10.26 ||
children.translated_text: The triple <s>Tārā</s>, the seventh <s>mudrā</s>, <s>Śiva</s> conjoined with <s>Śakti</s>, the pair of '<s>aham</s>' (I am) — these five in forward order — this is the <s>Śāmbhavī Vidyā</s>, consisting of pure knowledge (<s>śuddha-jñāna-mayī</s>). [Parks 10.26]

children.text: bhṛgu-triśūla-visṛṣṭayaḥ parā-vidyā || Parks_10.27 ||
children.translated_text: The <s>bhṛgu</s> and <s>triśūla</s> (trident) emanations — [this is] the <s>Parā Vidyā</s> (Supreme formula). [Parks 10.27]

children.text: pañcemā raśmayo mūlâdy-adhiṣṭhānatayā parikalpanīyāḥ || Parks_10.28 ||
children.translated_text: These five rays (<s>raśmis</s>) should be assigned as presiding over the root [<s>mantra</s>] and the others. [Parks 10.28]

children.text: vāk-kāma-śaktayo 'nuloma-vilomāḥ punar anulomāḥ - iti śriyo 'ṅga-bālā || Parks_10.29 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vāk</s> (Speech), <s>Kāma</s> (Desire), and <s>Śakti</s> (Power) in forward order, reverse order, and again forward order — this is the limb of <s>Śrī</s> (<s>Lalitā</s>), [called] <s>Aṅga-Bālā</s> (subsidiary <s>Bālā</s>). [Parks 10.29]

children.text: bhuvanā kamalā subhagā tāro namo bhagavati pūrṇe śekharam anna mamâbhilaṣitam uktvā 'nnaṃ dehi dahana-jāyeti śriya upâṅgam anna-pūrṇā || Parks_10.30 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bhuvanā</s>, <s>Kamalā</s>, <s>Subhagā</s>, <s>Tāra</s> (Oṃ), '<s>namo Bhagavati Pūrṇe</s>' (Homage, O Blessed Complete One), '<s>śekhara</s>' (crest), 'food, may my desire be fulfilled,' having said, 'give food,' '<s>dahana-jāyā</s>' (wife of fire) — this is the sub-limb (<s>upāṅga</s>) of <s>Śrī</s>, [called] <s>Annapūrṇā</s> (the Full of Food). [Parks 10.30]

children.text: praṇavaḥ pāśâdi-try-arṇā ehi parameśvarîty uktvā vahni-vāmâkṣy-uktir iti śrī-pratyaṅgam aśvârūḍhā || Parks_10.31 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), the three syllables beginning with '<s>pāśa</s>' (noose), '<s>ehi Parameśvarī</s>' (come, O Supreme Goddess), having said this, the utterance of '<s>vahni-vāmākṣī</s>' (fire and left eye) — this is the counter-limb (<s>pratyaṅga</s>) of <s>Śrī</s>, [called] <s>Aśvārūḍhā</s> (Mounted on a Horse). [Parks 10.31]

children.text: tāri-trikaṃ saptama-mudrā śiva-śakti-saṃvarta-pu-pañcama-purandara-va-ra-yūṃ śakti-śiva-kṣa-mânte vâdi-va-ra-yīṃ śiva-bhṛgu-triśūla-bindu-bhṛgu-śiva-triśūla-visṛṣṭayaḥ śrī-pūrvaṃ sva-guru-nāmato 'ṣṭâkṣarī ceti śrī-pādukā ca || Parks_10.32 ||
children.translated_text: The triple <s>Tārī</s>, the seventh <s>mudrā</s>, <s>Śiva</s>-<s>Śakti</s>-<s>Saṃvarta</s>-<s>pu</s>-fifth-<s>Purandara</s>-<s>va-ra-yūṃ</s>, <s>Śakti</s>-<s>Śiva</s>-<s>kṣa-ma</s> at the end, <s>vādi-va-ra-yīṃ</s>, <s>Śiva</s>-<s>bhṛgu</s>-<s>triśūla</s>-<s>bindu</s>-<s>bhṛgu</s>-<s>Śiva</s>-<s>triśūla</s>-emanations, preceded by '<s>Śrī</s>,' and an eight-syllabled [formula] from one's own guru's name — this is the <s>Śrī-pādukā</s> (sacred sandal of the Goddess). [Parks 10.32]

children.text: etābhiś catasṛbhir yuktā mūla-vidyā sāmrājñī mūlâdhāre vilocanīyā || Parks_10.33 ||
children.translated_text: The root <s>vidyā</s>, endowed with these four [subsidiary formulas], is the sovereign empress (<s>sāmrājñī</s>), to be contemplated in the <s>mūlādhāra</s> (root center). [Parks 10.33]

children.text: mādana-śakti-bindu-mālinī-vāsava-māyâghoṣa-doṣākara-kandarpa-gagana-maghavad-bhuvana-bhṛgu-puṣpabāṇa-bhū-māyeti seyaṃ tasyā mahā-vidyā || Parks_10.34 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mādana</s>, <s>Śakti</s>, <s>Bindu</s>, <s>Mālinī</s>, <s>Vāsava</s>, <s>Māyā</s>, '<s>ghoṣa</s>' (sound), <s>Doṣākara</s> (Moon), <s>Kandarpa</s>, <s>Gagana</s> (Sky), <s>Maghavat</s>, <s>Bhuvana</s>, <s>Bhṛgu</s>, <s>Puṣpabāṇa</s> (Flower-Arrowed One), <s>Bhū</s>, <s>Māyā</s> — this indeed is her great <s>vidyā</s> (<s>mahā-vidyā</s>). [Parks 10.34]

children.text: vāṅ-natir ucchiṣṭa-cāṇḍali mātam uktvā gi sarva-padād vaśaṅkari vahni-vāma-locaneti śyāmā-'ṅgaṃ laghu-śyāmā || Parks_10.35 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Vāṃ</s>,' salutation, '<s>Ucchiṣṭa-Cāṇḍālī</s>' (the Outcaste of Remnants), having said '<s>mātam</s>' — '<s>gī</s>,' from the word '<s>sarva</s>' (all), '<s>vaśaṅkari</s>' (O Subjugator), '<s>vahni-vāma-locana</s>' (fire and left eye) — this is the limb (<s>aṅga</s>) of <s>Śyāmā</s>, [called] <s>Laghu-Śyāmā</s> (Short <s>Śyāmā</s>). [Parks 10.35]

children.text: kumārīm uccārya vada-dvandvaṃ vāk-padaṃ vādini vahni-priyeti śyāmopāṅgaṃ vāg-vādinī || Parks_10.36 ||
children.translated_text: Having uttered '<s>Kumārī</s>,' the doubled word '<s>vada</s>' (speak), the word '<s>vāk</s>' (speech), '<s>Vādinī</s>' (the Speaker), '<s>vahni-priyā</s>' (beloved of fire) — this is the sub-limb (<s>upāṅga</s>) of <s>Śyāmā</s>, [called] <s>Vāgvādinī</s> (the Eloquent Speaker). [Parks 10.36]

children.text: praṇava o-pi-nā-ku-daṃ-pa-vṛ-pa-sa-syai-ca-śā-cā-mā-ha-da-śabdāḥ, ṣṭhā-dhā-na-lī-taiḥ-ri-tā-viḥ-rva-vā-ī-nā-ru-mi-vā-yec-chekharā, nakulī śyāmā-pratyaṅgam || Parks_10.37 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), the words '<s>o-pi-nā-ku-daṃ-pa-vṛ-pa-sa-syai-ca-śā-cā-mā-ha-da</s>,' [and] '<s>ṣṭhā-dhā-na-lī-taiḥ-ri-tā-viḥ-rva-vā-ī-nā-ru-mi-vā-yec</s>' with the crest — [this is] <s>Nakulī</s>, the counter-limb (<s>pratyaṅga</s>) of <s>Śyāmā</s>. [Parks 10.37]

children.text: lalitā-pādukâdi-trika-sthāne kumārī yojyā śiṣṭaṃ tad-vat - iti śyāmā-pādukā ca || Parks_10.38 ||
children.translated_text: In place of the <s>Lalitā-pādukā</s> triad, <s>Kumārī</s> should be inserted; the rest is the same — this is the <s>Śyāmā-pādukā</s> (sacred sandal of <s>Śyāmā</s>). [Parks 10.38]

children.text: catasṛbhir yuktā hṛc-cakre śyāmā yaṣṭavyā || Parks_10.39 ||
children.translated_text: Endowed with the four [subsidiary formulas], <s>Śyāmā</s> should be worshiped in the heart-<s>cakra</s> (<s>hṛc-cakra</s>). [Parks 10.39]

children.text: tad-vidyā tu tritārī kumārī na-bha-va-śrī-taṃ-śva-sa-ja-ma-hā-sa-mu-raṃ-ni-māyā-sa-rā-va-ka-sa-strī-ru-va-ka-sa-du-mṛ-va-ka-sa-sa-va-ka-sa-lo-va-ka-a-kaṃ-va-mā-ya-hā-varṇā oṃ-mo-ga-ti-mā-gī-ri-rva-na-no-ri-rva-kha-ji-madana-śrīṃ-rva-ja-śaṃ-ri-rva-pu-ṣa-śaṃ-ri-rva-ṣṭa-ga-śaṃ-ri-rva-tva-śaṃ-ri-rva-ka-śaṃ-ri-mu-me-śa-na-svā-'nta mantrâdi bīja-ṣaṭkaṃ prātilomyam iti aṣṭanavati-varṇāḥ || Parks_10.40 ||
children.translated_text: Her <s>vidyā</s>, however, is: the triple <s>Tārī</s>, '<s>Kumārī</s>,' '<s>na-bha-va-śrī-taṃ-śva-sa-ja-ma-hā-sa-mu-raṃ-ni-māyā-sa-rā-va-ka-sa-strī-ru-va-ka-sa-du-mṛ-va-ka-sa-sa-va-ka-sa-lo-va-ka-a-kaṃ-va-mā-ya-hā</s>' — these syllables — '<s>oṃ-mo-ga-ti-mā-gī-ri-rva-na-no-ri-rva-kha-ji-madana-śrīṃ-rva-ja-śaṃ-ri-rva-pu-ṣa-śaṃ-ri-rva-ṣṭa-ga-śaṃ-ri-rva-tva-śaṃ-ri-rva-ka-śaṃ-ri-mu-me-śa-na-svā</s>' at the end, the <s>mantra</s>-beginning, the six seeds in reverse order — thus ninety-eight syllables. [Parks 10.40]

children.text: haraḥ sa-bindur vā-pūrva-rāhi sthāṇuḥ sa-bindur unmatta-padaṃ bhai-śabdo ravi-pādukābhyāṃ nama iti vārtāly-aṅgaṃ laghu-vārtālī || Parks_10.41 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Hara</s>' with <s>bindu</s>, '<s>vā</s>'-preceded '<s>rāhi</s>,' '<s>Sthāṇu</s>' with <s>bindu</s>, the word '<s>unmatta</s>' (frenzied), the syllable '<s>bhai</s>,' the <s>pādukā</s> of <s>Ravi</s> (Sun), '<s>namaḥ</s>' — this is the limb (<s>aṅga</s>) of <s>Vārtālī</s>, [called] <s>Laghu-Vārtālī</s> (Short <s>Vārtālī</s>). [Parks 10.41]

children.text: vedâdi-bhuvanaṃ namo vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ ṭha-dvitayaṃ agni-dārā - iti vārtāly-upāṅgaṃ svapna-vārtālī svapne śubhâśubha-phala-vaktrī || Parks_10.42 ||
children.translated_text: The '<s>Veda</s>'-beginning, '<s>Bhuvana</s>,' '<s>namo Vārāhi</s>' (Homage to <s>Vārāhī</s>), '<s>Ghore</s>' (O Terrible One), '<s>svapna</s>' (dream), the doubled '<s>ṭha</s>,' '<s>agni-dārā</s>' (wife of fire) — this is the sub-limb (<s>upāṅga</s>) of <s>Vārtālī</s>, [called] <s>Svapna-Vārtālī</s> (Dream <s>Vārtālī</s>), the revealer of auspicious and inauspicious results in dreams. [Parks 10.42]

children.text: vāg ghṛdayaṃ bhagavati tiraskariṇi mahā-māye paśu-padāj jana-manaś-cakṣus-tiraskaraṇaṃ kuru-dvitayaṃ varma phaṭ pāvaka-parigraha iti vārtālī-pratyaṅgaṃ, tiraskariṇī || Parks_10.43 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Vāk</s>' (Speech), '<s>hṛdayam</s>' (heart), '<s>Bhagavati Tiraskariṇī Mahāmāye</s>' (O Blessed Concealer, O Great Illusion), from the word '<s>paśu</s>' (beast), 'of the people, conceal the mind and eyes' (<s>jana-manaś-cakṣus-tiraskaraṇam</s>), the doubled '<s>kuru</s>' (do, do), '<s>varma</s>' (armor), '<s>phaṭ</s>,' '<s>pāvaka-parigraha</s>' (embraced by fire) — this is the counter-limb (<s>pratyaṅga</s>) of <s>Vārtālī</s>, [called] <s>Tiraskariṇī</s> (the Concealer). [Parks 10.43]

children.text: śyāmā-pādukā-mantrâdi-tri-bījam apahāya vāg glaum - iti yojyam | eṣā vārtālī-pādukā || Parks_10.44 ||
children.translated_text: Removing the three seeds at the beginning of the <s>Śyāmā-pādukā mantra</s> and inserting '<s>vāg glauṃ</s>' — this is the <s>Vārtālī-pādukā</s> (sacred sandal of <s>Vārtālī</s>). [Parks 10.44]

children.text: vidyābhir etābhir yuktā phāla-cakre paripūjyā bhagavatîyaṃ bhūdāra-mukhī || Parks_10.45 ||
children.translated_text: Endowed with [these] <s>vidyās</s>, this blessed Boar-Faced One (<s>Bhūdāra-mukhī</s>) should be worshiped in the forehead-<s>cakra</s> (<s>phāla-cakra</s>). [Parks 10.45]

children.text: manur idam īyo 'yaṃ vāk-puṭitaṃ glauṃ na-bha-va-vā-li-rtā-vā-hi-rā-va-ha-khi-rā-mu-aṃ-aṃ-ni-maḥ-dhe-dhi-na-jaṃ-jaṃ-ni-maḥ-he-hi-na-staṃ-staṃ-ni-maḥ-rva-ṣṭa-du-nāṃ-rve-sa-vāk-tta-kṣu-kha-ti-hvā-bha-ku-ku-śī-va-śabdā yathā-kramaṃ mo-ga-ti-rtā-vā-li-rā-vā-hi-rā-mu-va-ha-khi-dhe-dhi-na-ruṃ-ruṃ-ni-maḥ-bhe-bhi-na-mo-mo-ni-maḥ-bhe-bhi-na-sa-du-pra-ṣṭā-sa-ṣāṃ-rva-ci-ca-rmu-ga-ji-staṃ-naṃ-ru-ru-ghraṃ-śyaṃ-śabdopetā vāk glauṃ visṛṣṭy-antāś ca saptamāś catvāro varmâstrāya phaḍ iti dvādaśottaraśatâkṣarā || Parks_10.46 ||
children.translated_text: This is her <s>mantra</s>: this adorable one, enclosed by '<s>vāk</s>,' '<s>glauṃ</s> <s>na-bha-va-vā-li-rtā-vā-hi-rā-va-ha-khi-rā-mu-aṃ-aṃ-ni-maḥ-dhe-dhi-na-jaṃ-jaṃ-ni-maḥ-he-hi-na-staṃ-staṃ-ni-maḥ-rva-ṣṭa-du-nāṃ-rve-sa-vāk-tta-kṣu-kha-ti-hvā-bha-ku-ku-śī-va</s>' — these syllables in order — '<s>mo-ga-ti-rtā-vā-li-rā-vā-hi-rā-mu-va-ha-khi-dhe-dhi-na-ruṃ-ruṃ-ni-maḥ-bhe-bhi-na-mo-mo-ni-maḥ-bhe-bhi-na-sa-du-pra-ṣṭā-sa-ṣāṃ-rva-ci-ca-rmu-ga-ji-staṃ-naṃ-ru-ru-ghraṃ-śyaṃ</s>' with these syllables, '<s>vāk glauṃ</s>' ending with emanations, and the seventh [syllables], four armor-weapon '<s>phaṭ</s>' — thus one hundred and twelve syllables. [Parks 10.46]

children.text: pañcamaikādaśa-bīja-varjā śrīr eva śrī-pūrti-vidyā brahma-koṭare yaṣṭavyā || Parks_10.47 ||
children.translated_text: Excluding the fifth and eleventh seeds, '<s>Śrī</s>' alone — [this is] the <s>Śrī-pūrti Vidyā</s> (Fullness of <s>Śrī</s> formula), to be worshiped in the <s>Brahma-koṭara</s> (cavity of <s>Brahman</s>). [Parks 10.47]

children.text: śyāmā-pādukā-prathama-trika-sthāne tāra-trayaṃ kumārī vāk glauṃ - iti yojyam | tataḥ parastāc cheṣaṃ samānam || Parks_10.48 ||
children.translated_text: In place of the first triad of the <s>Śyāmā-pādukā</s>, the triple <s>Tāra</s>, '<s>Kumārī</s>,' '<s>vāk glauṃ</s>' should be inserted; thereafter the remainder is the same. [Parks 10.48]

children.text: iyaṃ mahā-pādukā sarva-mantra-samaṣṭi-rūpiṇī svaikya-vimarśinī mahā-siddhi-pradāyinī dvādaśânte yaṣṭavyā || Parks_10.49 ||
children.translated_text: This is the Great <s>Pādukā</s> (<s>Mahā-pādukā</s>), the collective form of all <s>mantras</s> (<s>sarva-mantra-samaṣṭi-rūpiṇī</s>), the reflector of one's own unity (<s>svaikya-vimarśinī</s>), the bestower of great <s>siddhis</s> (accomplishments) — she should be worshiped at the <s>dvādaśānta</s> (the point twelve finger-breadths above the head). [Parks 10.49]

children.text: evaṃ raśmi-mālā sampūrṇā | sarva-gātraḥ śuddha-vidyā-maya-tanuḥ sa eva parama-śivaḥ || Parks_10.50 ||
children.translated_text: Thus the garland of rays (<s>raśmi-mālā</s>) is complete. One whose entire body is made of pure <s>vidyā</s> — that one is indeed <s>Paramaśiva</s> (the Supreme <s>Śiva</s>). [Parks 10.50]

children.text: atha vighna-devatāḥ | iri-mili-kiri-kili-padāt parimirom ity ekaḥ | praṇavo māyā namo bhagavati mahā-tripurād bhai-varṇād ravi-padam anu mama traipurarakṣāṃ kuru kuru - iti dvitīyaḥ | saṃhara saṃhara vighna-rakṣo-vibhīṣakān kālaya huṃ phaṭ svāhā - iti tṛtīyaḥ | blūṃ raktābhyo yoginībhyo namaḥ - iti caturthaḥ | sāṃ sārasāya bahv-āśanāya namaḥ - iti pañcamaḥ | dumuluṣu muluṣu māyā cāmuṇḍāyai namaḥ - iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ | ete manavo lalitā-japa-vighna-devatāḥ || Parks_10.51 ||
children.translated_text: Now, the obstacle-deities (<s>vighna-devatās</s>): '<s>iri-mili-kiri-kili</s>,' from the word '<s>parimirom</s>' — this is the first. <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ), <s>Māyā</s>, '<s>namo Bhagavati</s>,' from '<s>Mahā-Tripura</s>,' from the syllable '<s>bhai</s>,' following the word '<s>Ravi</s>' (Sun), 'protect, protect me with the protection of <s>Tripura</s>' — this is the second. 'Destroy, destroy the terrifying obstacle-<s>rākṣasas</s>, <s>kālaya huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>' — this is the third. '<s>blūṃ</s>, to the red <s>Yoginīs</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' — this is the fourth. '<s>sāṃ</s>, to <s>Sārasa</s> (the Crane), the voracious eater, <s>namaḥ</s>' — this is the fifth. '<s>dumuluṣu muluṣu</s>, <s>Māyā</s>, to <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>' — this is the sixth. These <s>mantras</s> are the obstacle-deities for the <s>japa</s> (recitation) of <s>Lalitā</s>. [Parks 10.51]

children.text: hasanti hasitâlāpe padaṃ mātam uktvā gī-paricārike mama bhaya-vighna-nāśaṃ kuru-dvitayaṃ sa-visarga-ṭha-tritayam iti śyāmā-vighna-devī || Parks_10.52 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Hasanti hasitālāpe</s>' (in the laughing conversation), the word, having said '<s>mātam</s>' — '<s>gī-paricārike</s>' (O attendant of song), 'destroy, destroy my fear and obstacles,' the doubled '<s>kuru</s>,' the tripled '<s>ṭha</s>' with <s>visarga</s> — this is the obstacle-goddess of <s>Śyāmā</s>. [Parks 10.52]

children.text: staṃ stambhinyai namaḥ - iti kola-mukhī-vighna-devī || Parks_10.53 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>staṃ</s>' — homage to <s>Stambhinī</s> (the Paralyzer) — thus ends the obstacle-deity [section] of <s>Kolamukhī</s> (Boar-Faced).

children.text: ete tat-taj-japârambhe japtavyāḥ || Parks_10.54 ||
children.translated_text: These should be recited at the commencement of each respective <s>japa</s> (recitation).

children.text: lalitā prāhṇe | aparâhṇe śyāmā | vārtālī rātrau | brāhme muhūrte parā || Parks_10.55 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Lalitā</s> in the forenoon; <s>Śyāmā</s> in the afternoon; <s>Vārtālī</s> at night; <s>Parā</s> at the <s>brāhma muhūrta</s> (pre-dawn hour).

children.text: vyavahāra-deśa-svâtmya-prāṇodvega-sahāyâmaya-vayāṃsi pravicāryaiva tad-anukūlaḥ pañca-mâdi-parāmarśaḥ || Parks_10.56 ||
children.translated_text: Having duly considered the customs of the region, one's own nature, the vitality of one's breath, companions, illness, and age — one should engage with the five <s>ma</s>-s (ritual substances) in a manner suited to those [conditions].

children.text: sarva-bhūtair avirodhaḥ || Parks_10.57 ||
children.translated_text: Non-hostility toward all beings.

children.text: paripanthiṣu nigrahaḥ || Parks_10.58 ||
children.translated_text: Punishment of adversaries.

children.text: anugrahaḥ saṃśriteṣu || Parks_10.59 ||
children.translated_text: Grace toward those who have taken refuge.

children.text: guru-vat guru-putra-kalatrâdiṣu vṛttiḥ || Parks_10.60 ||
children.translated_text: One should conduct oneself toward the <s>Guru</s>'s sons, wives, and others as one would toward the <s>Guru</s> himself.

children.text: ādimasya svayaṃ sevanam āgama-dṛṣṭyā doṣa-daṃ tyājyam || Parks_10.61 ||
children.translated_text: The self-partaking of the first [substance] is fault-producing from the standpoint of the <s>Āgama</s> and should be abandoned.

children.text: sânandasya rucirasyâmodino laghuno vārkṣasya gauḍasya piṣṭa-prakṛtinaḥ andhaso vālkalasya kausumasya vā yathā-deśa-siddhasya vā tasya parigrahaḥ || Parks_10.62 ||
children.translated_text: One should accept that [substance] which is joyful, pleasant, fragrant, light — whether from trees, from sugarcane, of flour-nature, of bark-origin, or from flowers — or whatever is locally available.

children.text: tad-anantaraṃ madhyamayor asvayam asu-vimocanam | upādime nâyaṃ niyamaḥ | madhyame tu svayaṃ saṃjñapane tatrâyaṃ mantraḥ -
udbudhyasva paśo tvaṃ hi nâśivas tvaṃ śivo hy asi |
children.translated_text: Awaken, O <s>paśu</s> (bound soul)! For you are not inauspicious — you are indeed <s>Śiva</s> (auspicious).

children.text: śivotkṛttam idaṃ piṇḍaṃ mattas tvaṃ śivatāṃ vraja ||
children.translated_text: This body has been severed by <s>Śiva</s>; from me, go forth to the state of <s>Śiva</s>.

Thereafter, for the middle two [substances], one should not oneself take life. For the first, this restriction does not apply. But for the middle one, when one oneself performs the ritual killing, here is the <s>mantra</s>:

children.text: iti || Parks_10.63 ||
children.translated_text: Thus [ends the section].

children.text: sarvatra vacana-pūrvaṃ pravṛttiḥ || Parks_10.64 ||
children.translated_text: In all matters, action should be preceded by speech (verbal declaration).

children.text: daśa-kula-vṛkṣânupaplavaḥ || Parks_10.65 ||
children.translated_text: One should not harm the ten family-trees.

children.text: strī-vṛndâdima-kalaśa-siddha-liṅgi-krīḍā-''kula-kumārī-kula-sahakārâśokaika-taru-paretâvani-matta-veśyā-śyāmā-rakta-vasanā-mattebhānāṃ darśane vandanam || Parks_10.66 ||
children.translated_text: Upon seeing a group of women, the first sacred vessel, a <s>siddha</s> (perfected being), a <s>liṅgin</s> (one bearing the sacred mark), a play-gathering, a <s>kumārī</s> (maiden), a family gathering, a mango tree, an <s>aśoka</s> tree, a solitary tree, a cremation ground, an intoxicated person, a courtesan, a dark-complexioned woman, a woman clad in red, or a rutting elephant — one should offer salutation.

children.text: pañca-parvasu viśeṣârcā || Parks_10.67 ||
children.translated_text: On the five <s>parvan</s> days (juncture-days), special worship should be performed.

children.text: ārambha-taruṇa-yauvana-prauḍha-tadantonmanânavasthollāseṣu prauḍhântāḥ samayâcārāḥ | tataḥ paraṃ yathā-kāmī | svaira-vyavahāreṣu vīrâvīreṣv ayathā-mananād adhaḥ pātaḥ || Parks_10.68 ||
children.translated_text: At the stages of beginning, early youth, full maturity, and the exaltation at the end of that — up to the stage of maturity are the <s>samayācāras</s> (conventional observances). Beyond that, one acts according to one's own desire. But in spontaneous conduct, through incorrect contemplation of the heroic and the non-heroic, there is downfall.

children.text: raktā-tyāga-viraktā-''kramaṇodāsīnā-pralobhana-varjanam || Parks_10.69 ||
children.translated_text: One should avoid: approaching a passionate woman, abandoning [a willing one], approaching a dispassionate woman, and enticing an indifferent one.

children.text: ghṛṇā-śaṅkā-bhaya-lajjā-jugupsā-kula-jāti-śīlānāṃ krameṇâvasādanam || Parks_10.70 ||
children.translated_text: One should progressively overcome: disgust, doubt, fear, shame, aversion, [attachment to] family, caste, and [conventional] moral conduct.

children.text: guru-praguru-sannipāte praguroḥ prathamaṃ praṇatiḥ tad-agre tad-anurodhena tan-nati-varjanam || Parks_10.71 ||
children.translated_text: When one's <s>Guru</s> and grand-<s>Guru</s> are present together, one should first prostrate to the grand-<s>Guru</s>. Before him, out of deference to him, one should refrain from bowing to the [immediate] <s>Guru</s>.

children.text: abhyarhiteṣv aparāṅmukhyam || Parks_10.72 ||
children.translated_text: One should not turn away from those who are worthy of honor.

children.text: mukhyatayā prakāśa-vibhāvanā || Parks_10.73 ||
children.translated_text: One should principally manifest and reveal the luminous [teaching].

children.text: adhijigamiṣā śarīrârthâsūnāṃ gurave dhāraṇam || Parks_10.74 ||
children.translated_text: With the desire to master [the teaching], one should dedicate one's body, wealth, and life-breath to the <s>Guru</s>.

children.text: etad-ukta-karaṇam || Parks_10.75 ||
children.translated_text: One should carry out what has been stated [by the Guru].

children.text: aparīkṣaṇaṃ tad-vacane vyavasthā || Parks_10.76 ||
children.translated_text: Without scrutiny, one should abide by his word.

children.text: sarvathā satya-vacanam || Parks_10.77 ||
children.translated_text: In all circumstances, one should speak the truth.

children.text: para-dāra-dhaneṣv anāsaktiḥ || Parks_10.78 ||
children.translated_text: Non-attachment toward others' wives and wealth.

children.text: sva-stuti-para-nindā-marma-viruddha-vacana-parihāsa-dhikkārâkrośa-trāsana-varjanam || Parks_10.79 ||
children.translated_text: One should avoid: self-praise, censure of others, speaking against vulnerable points, contradictory speech, mockery, reproach, verbal abuse, and intimidation.

children.text: prayatnena vidyā-''rādhana-dvārā pūrṇa-khyāti-samāveśanecchā cety ete sāmāyikâcārāḥ || Parks_10.80 ||
children.translated_text: With effort, the desire to attain full realization through the door of worship of the <s>Vidyā</s> — these are the <s>sāmāyikācāras</s> (conventional observances).

children.text: pare ca śāstrânuśiṣṭāḥ || Parks_10.81 ||
children.translated_text: And the remaining [observances] are as taught in the <s>śāstras</s>.

children.text: itthaṃ viditvā vidhi-vad anuṣṭhitavataḥ kula-niṣṭhasya sarvataḥ kṛta-kṛtyatā śarīra-tyāge śvapaca-gṛha-kāśyor nântaraṃ jīvan-muktaḥ || Parks_10.82 ||
children.translated_text: Having thus known and duly practiced, for the one established in the <s>Kula</s> tradition, there is complete fulfillment in all respects. At the time of leaving the body, there is no difference [in liberation] between a <s>caṇḍāla</s>'s house and <s>Kāśī</s> (Varanasi) — one is liberated while living (<s>jīvanmukta</s>).

children.text: ya imāṃ daśa-khaṇḍīṃ mahopaniṣadaṃ mahā-traipura-siddhānta-sarvasva-bhūtām adhīte saḥ - sarveṣu yajñeṣu yaṣṭā bhavati yaṃ yaṃ kratum adhīte tena tenâsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati iti hi śrūyate ity upaniṣat - iti śivam || Parks_10.83 ||
children.translated_text: Whoever studies this ten-sectioned great <s>Upaniṣad</s>, which is the entire essence of the great <s>Traipura Siddhānta</s> — he becomes the performer of all sacrifices. 'Whatever sacrificial rite one studies, by that very rite one's sacrifice is accomplished' — thus it is heard [in the <s>Veda</s>]. Thus ends the <s>Upaniṣad</s>. <s>Iti Śivam</s> (Thus, may there be auspiciousness).

children.text: athâtaḥ sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ, atha sveṣṭa-mantrasya, iti vidhi-vat, itthaṃ sâṅgāṃ, iyam eva mahatī vidyā, atha prāthamike caturasre, atha hṛc-cakra-sthitāṃ, evaṃ gaṇapatim iṣṭvā, itthaṃ sad-guroḥ, athâto dīkṣāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | atha, evam, atha, ittham, atha sveṣṭeti pañca || Parks_10.84 ||
children.translated_text: Now, regarding all <s>mantras</s>; now, regarding one's chosen <s>mantra</s>; thus according to the prescribed method; thus with all its limbs; this alone is the great <s>Vidyā</s>; now, in the first square; now, [the Devī] established in the heart-<s>cakra</s>; thus having worshiped <s>Gaṇapati</s>; thus from the true <s>Guru</s>; now we shall expound initiation (<s>dīkṣā</s>). These are the five [opening sūtras] beginning with '<s>atha</s>,' '<s>evam</s>,' '<s>atha</s>,' '<s>ittham</s>,' '<s>atha sveṣṭa</s>.'

children.text: iti śrī-duṣṭa-kṣatriya-kula-kālântaka-reṇukā-garbha-sambhūta-mahādeva-pradhāna-śiṣya-jāmadagnya-śrī-paraśurāma-bhārgava-mahopādhyāya-mahā-kulâcārya-nirmitaṃ kalpa-sūtraṃ saṃpūrṇam || Parks_10.85 ||
children.translated_text: Thus is completed the <s>Kalpasūtra</s> composed by the great preceptor, the great <s>Kulācārya</s>, <s>Śrī Paraśurāma Bhārgava</s>, <s>Jāmadagnya</s>, the foremost disciple of <s>Mahādeva</s>, born from the womb of <s>Reṇukā</s>, the destroyer of the lineage of wicked <s>Kṣatriyas</s>.
